Imbalance runs white spot → cavity through enamel → dentin (30% collagen, 3x faster) → pulp. Eight 5 g sugar hits a day beat one 40 g dessert - frequency sets the pH curve. In essence: a balance between dissolution and precipitation, won by letting remineralization win every interval.) ✅ **tooth-enamel/**
- [x] RAAS & Blood Volume (the body's own pressure valve is a three-stage pipeline: when BP or volume falls, the juxtaglomerular apparatus senses it three ways - JG-cell baroreceptors in the afferent arteriole, the macula densa reading falling tubular NaCl, and sympathetic β1 input - and releases renin. Renin is an enzyme, not a hormone: it cuts liver-made angiotensinogen (452 aa) to release the decapeptide Ang I, which rides the blood through the lungs where dense endothelial ACE clips two amino acids to make the octapeptide Ang II - among the strongest pressors in the body. One molecule, four jobs: constrict vessels (TPR up), drive aldosterone from the adrenal zona glomerulosa, trigger ADH and thirst, and boost proximal Na+/H+ exchange. Aldosterone has a ~90 min latency (gene transcription), opens ENaC to reclaim Na+ and excrete K+ with water following - of 180 L of filtrate a day, 99%+ is reclaimed, and this fine-tune sets blood volume. As MAP returns to ~100 mmHg, negative feedback shuts renin off; ACEI (captopril), ARB (losartan) and spironolactone block the loop at ACE, the AT1 receptor and the aldosterone receptor. In essence: a renin→Ang II→volume chain holding pressure at its set point as a closed negative-feedback valve.) ✅ **raas/**
- [x] Geiger-Müller Counter (A cylindrical wall serves as cathode, a central 25-100 um tungsten wire as anode, the tube filled with Ar or Ne plus ~10% quench gas at 400-900 V. Coaxial geometry makes the radial field E = V/(r ln(R/r)) tighten as 1/r: the average field is a mere ~10^4 V/m, yet the wire surface reaches 10^6 V/m. An incident beta or gamma ray frees only 1-10 ion pairs, but each electron drifts toward the wire and, in the last ~0.1 mm, re-ionizes every mean free path - a Townsend avalanche doubling per generation to a gain of 10^8-10^10. UV photons from the avalanche ignite fresh ones elsewhere, sweeping the whole tube in under a microsecond - so pulse height is independent of the initial ionization: it counts, never measures energy, the dividing line from the proportional counter. Electrons are collected in microseconds; the positive ion sheath needs 100-500 us to drift back, creating a 50-300 us dead time during which counts are lost as m = n/(1+n*tau). Ions striking the wall would eject secondaries and re-trigger; the quench gas absorbs the UV, transfers the charge and lands as a neutral - organics last ~10^8 counts, halogens regenerate. The operating voltage is pinned on the plateau (slope <10%/100 V) between the ~400 V starting point and continuous discharge. Survey meters, dosimeters and cosmic-ray surveys all rely on it. In essence: a gas amplifier that turns one electron into one countable click.) ✅ **geiger-counter/**
- [x] Van de Graaff Generator (A Van de Graaff generator makes high voltage by mechanical transport. The bottom corona comb is a row of needle points at 5-10 kV to ground: tips tens of microns across push the field to ~10^8 V/m, ionizing air and spraying like charge onto an insulating belt. A motor runs the belt up at ~10 m/s - literally a vertical current I = sigma*v*w of 10-100 uA in classroom units. Inside the top sphere Gauss's law guarantees E=0, so a second comb scrapes the charge off without any opposition, and it immediately spreads over the outer surface. Charge flows in and never out: Q = It grows, and the potential V = Q/(4*pi*e0*R) climbs - the capacitance is only tens of pF, so 40 uA gives dV/dt of about 1.4 MV/s. The ceiling is air breakdown: when the surface field E = V/R reaches 3 MV/m the sphere discharges, giving V_max of about 3xR (MV, R in meters); larger polished spheres in SF6-filled tanks reach megavolts. Hair stands because every strand shares the same charge, and the smallest curvature radius discharges first - the point effect. Tandem accelerators exploit the same elevator for nuclear physics: negative ions fall toward the +V terminal, a stripper foil flips their charge, and they are pushed again - 2qV per ion. In essence: an elevator that carries electric charge to the top of the sphere.) ✅ **van-de-graaff/**
- [x] Shock-Wave Lithotripsy (Extracorporeal shock-wave lithotripsy replaces surgery with geometry. In an electrohydraulic lithotripter an underwater spark gap discharges: the expanding plasma channel launches a single-cycle pressure pulse - a 40-80 MPa positive peak with a ~10 ns rise and ~1 us width, trailed by roughly -5 MPa of tension. The spark sits at F1, the first focus of a brass ellipsoid, whose equal-path property (2a = 30 cm) makes every part of the spherical wavefront arrive at the second focus F2 simultaneously; the front adds in phase into a ~10 mm focal spot locked on the kidney stone, while at the skin entry the wave has spread below 0.2 MPa - a water cushion matches acoustic impedance and tissue is unharmed. Two mechanisms break the stone. First, the compressive wave crosses the stone and reflects at the far interface as tension: stone tensile strength is only 0.2-0.5 MPa, far below its compressive strength, so the surface spalls off in layers. Second, the negative phase tears cavitation bubbles out of the surrounding fluid; they grow, collapse violently, and fire ~100 m/s microjets that erode the surface. Shocks are spaced ~0.25-1 s (1-4 Hz) to let the bubble cloud clear, and a session delivers 1000-3000 of them under live imaging. In essence: blasting turned into a repeatable, aimable acoustic event.) ✅ **lithotripsy/**
- [x] Meteorites & the Oldest Solids (chondrites make up ~86% of falls and preserve the nebula's sediment un-rewritten: millimeter chondrules (0.5-2 mm) are droplets flash-melted in transient heating events and quenched within minutes to hours at 4565-4567 Ma, while calcium-aluminum-rich inclusions condensed first in the hottest nebula zone (>1400 K) at 4567.3±0.16 Ma - the oldest known solids and the zero point of all Pb-Pb dating; only a melted, differentiated parent yields achondrites (500+ lunar, ~300 Martian such as ALH84001, HED from Vesta) and irons (the parent's metal core, Ni 5-20%). Entry at 11-72 km/s carries specific kinetic energy ½v² - ~2.6×10⁹ J/kg at 72 km/s, 600+ kg of TNT per kilogram - and ablation strips ~90% of the mass while melting a ~1 mm black glass fusion crust; small stones brake to 90-200 m/s terminal velocity. The Widmanstätten pattern in etched irons is kamacite/taenite intergrowth grown along octahedral {111} planes under 1-10 °C/Myr cooling, band width ∝ 1/cooling rate back-solving parent radii of tens to hundreds of km; cosmic-ray exposure ages (cosmogenic ³He, ²¹Ne buildup) time the flight since the parent broke up - a few to tens of Myr for chondrites, hundreds of Myr for irons. ~50,000-60,000 land each year, mostly at sea. In essence: un-rewritten pages of the parent bodies, reading out nebula events, planetary anatomy and flight history.) ✅ **meteorite/**
- [x] Celestial Coordinates & the Equatorial Mount (stars carry two addresses: right ascension RA (0-24 h) and declination Dec (±90°) are pinned to the celestial sphere and never change, while altitude/azimuth rotates with time and place - the two systems convert every minute via sin(alt) = sinδ sinφ + cosδ cosφ cos(HA). Sidereal time keeps the 23h56m04.09s sidereal day, 3m56s faster than the solar day, and a star's hour angle HA = LST − RA hits zero at transit. An equatorial mount sets its polar axis tilt equal to the latitude and aims it due north, so the axis meets the celestial pole and the sky's daily motion collapses to a single degree of freedom: rotation about that axis at 15.041 arcsec/s (360° per 86,164.09 s) - mechanically a synchronous motor and a worm. Alt-az mounts get no such gift: both axes must vary trigonometrically and the field itself rotates, demanding a derotator for long exposures. Tracking error × exposure = trailing: 0.1 arcsec/s over 300 s draws 30 arcsec (~87 µm at 600 mm focal length); no tracking draws 15.041 × 300 = 4512 arcsec = 1.25° across the frame. Polaris sits 0.7° from the true pole, drifting 50.2 arcsec/yr as the pole circles the ecliptic in 25,772 years - Thuban, Polaris, Vega taking turns. In essence: fixed street addresses for a turning sky, cancelled out by one axis turning at a constant rate.) ✅ **celestial-coordinates/**
- [x] Olbers' Paradox (in a static, infinite universe the night sky should blaze: starlight dims as 1/r² but a shell of radius r holds r² more stars, so every shell contributes the same flux and the infinite sum diverges - every line of sight ends on a stellar surface and the whole sky would glow like a 5800 K photosphere, ~10⁵ times daylight, with not even shadows. Measured reality: the night sky is ~10⁻⁴ of daylight, the Milky Way band ~10⁻¹¹, and the extragalactic background light (a few nW/m²/sr) fainter still - nine orders of magnitude missing. Three legs hold up the dark: the universe's finite age (13.8 Gyr) truncates the integral at the light-travel horizon r_H ≈ ct₀, so light from beyond simply has not arrived (after the CMB at z≈1100 came the dark ages; the first stars lit ~200 Myr later); expansion redshift (H₀ ≈ 67.4 km/s/Mpc) dims distant light by (1+z)⁴ - photon arrival diluted by 1/(1+z), photon energy reduced by 1/(1+z), cosmic area stretching another (1+z)² - the outermost shells at z≈0.92 dimmed ~13.6x; and stars burn for only ~10⁷-10¹¹ yr, so total emitted light = luminosity × burning time stays bounded while new stars still ignite. Edgar Allan Poe guessed the answer in 1848, seventy years ahead of the science. In essence: the dark night is not a backdrop but the signature of a universe with a beginning.) ✅ **olbers-paradox/**
- [x] Combined-Cycle Power Plant (the Brayton half owns the hot end: the compressor squeezes air to 18-23 bar, the combustor fires turbine inlet temperature to 1500-1600 °C — H-class blades survive on film cooling and thermal barrier coatings — and simple-cycle efficiency climbs with TIT from ~33% at 1200 °C to ~40% at 1500 °C; the exhaust still carries 550-650 °C into the HRSG, which burns nothing: gas descends through superheater (reheat to ~560 °C), evaporator (saturation at 130 bar ≈ 331 °C, the 8-15 K pinch is the choke) and economizer while water-steam climbs counter-current, squeezing the stack to ~100 °C. The Rankine half expands that steam to 0.05 bar, 30-40 °C in the condenser at η_R ≈ 36-38%. The cycles nearly add: η_cc = η_B + (1-η_B)·η_R ≈ 1-(1-η_B)(1-η_R) ≈ 61-64%, a full cut above ultra-supercritical coal's 45-47% and ~1/3 less CO2 per kWh; the single-shaft layout shares one generator, starts take 30-60 minutes (coal needs 4-8 hours), making it the grid's peaker, with inlet chilling adding 5-8% on hot days. In essence: two heat engines butt-joined on the temperature axis, relaying heat from 1500 °C down to 30 °C.) ✅ **combined-cycle/**
- [x] Fluidized Bed (air rises through a particle bed from the distributor: at low velocity grains rest on one another — a fixed bed — and pressure drop climbs with velocity; when Δp just balances the bed weight per area the bed levitates: minimum fluidization velocity umf, 0.05-0.5 m/s for 0.1-1 mm sand, from setting Ergun's viscous-plus-inertial drop equal to the submerged weight gradient (ρp-ρf)(1-εmf)g and solving the quadratic. Past umf, Δp plateaus and surplus gas gathers into bubbles — a bubble phase churning through an emulsion held at incipient fluidization; bubble wakes elevator grains bottom-to-surface, walls return them, and the whole bed remixes every 5-10 s, expanding 20-100% like boiling liquid, uniform to ±5 °C, with 3000-10000 m²/m³ of gas-solid contact and 200-500 W/(m²·K) wall heat transfer — an order above a packed bed. Fluidized-bed boilers burn at 850 °C — below the ~1300 °C thermal-NOx threshold — while in-bed limestone calcines to porous CaO that captures SO2 as CaSO4 at 90%, no scrubbing tower. Push to 10-30 m/s and a CFB cyclone returns entrained solids down the dipleg, looping the circuit several times a second — the FCC cracking pattern. In essence: fluidizing the solid phase so bubbles churn the whole bed into one isothermal, well-stirred reactor.) ✅ **fluidized-bed/**
- [x] Counterflow Heat Exchanger (parallel flow runs the two streams together: ΔT is largest at the inlet and converges to the outlet, so the cold stream can never leave hotter than the hot one — all the heat in the world only closes the gap; counterflow walks them into each other — the profiles stay nearly uniformly apart and the cold outlet may exceed the hot outlet: 90 °C hot water pushes 20 °C water to 77 °C while itself falling to 47 °C. The design ledger Q = U·A·LMTD with LMTD = (ΔT1-ΔT2)/ln(ΔT1/ΔT2): a uniform profile buys a larger LMTD and less area; in ε-NTU terms (NTU = UA/Cmin), at NTU=3 and Cr=0.75 counterflow reaches ε≈0.82 while parallel manages 0.36 — and parallel's ceiling 1/(1+Cr) ≈ 57% is unreachable with any amount of area, so in the high-recovery corner counterflow is the only option. Plate exchangers squeeze the channel to 2-5 mm; mirrored chevron corrugations trip turbulence at low Reynolds number: U = 3000-7000 W/(m²·K) versus 500-1500 for shell-and-tube, an order less volume for the same duty. Biology ran the trick first: fish gills run blood against water for 80-90% O2 uptake (concurrent gets ~50%), and penguin feet keep core heat with counterflow vessels. Fouling bleeds U slowly — a resistance of 0.0009 drags 4000 down to 900 — so performance is maintained by backflushing, not locked in at design. In essence: the temperature profile, not the metal, sets an exchanger's ceiling.) ✅ **heat-exchanger/**
- [x] KMP String Matching (Knuth, Morris & Pratt, 1977) imposes one discipline on string matching: the text pointer never backs up. Naive search is worst-case O(n·m) — against text AAAA…A, pattern AAAB fails on its last character every time and drags the text pointer back to window start +1, rereading everything just compared. KMP pays O(m) once to compute the failure function π[i] = the longest proper border of prefix p[0..i] (ABABACA → [0,0,1,2,3,0,1]); the build itself is KMP running the pattern against itself as its own text. During the scan, a mismatch makes the pattern pointer j fall to π[j−1] while i stays put: the matched segment's suffix equals the pattern's prefix, so every skipped alignment fails a necessary condition and cannot match — nothing is wasted. Total comparisons are bounded by 2n through an amortized ledger: each rise of j costs exactly one comparison, every mismatch drops j by at least 1, and total drops cannot exceed total rises, which cannot exceed n — no input can break it. As a bonus, π[m−1] yields the smallest period p = m − π[m−1], a one-line repeat detector (LZ compression, DNA repeat detection). Successors Boyer–Moore (1977) and Sunday (1990) skip faster on average, but KMP remains the model of trading preprocessing for never looking back. In essence: the information available at every mismatch is precomputed into a jump table.) ✅ **kmp/**
- [x] LSTM & Gated Memory (a plain RNN computes h_t=tanh(W·h_{t−1}+x), and backpropagation must multiply Jacobians across time: with ‖W‖<1 the product decays exponentially — 0.9^20 ≈ 0.12, 0.9^100 ≈ 3×10⁻⁵, below float resolution — so the loss at step 100 is essentially blind to what happened at step 1; Bengio named this wall in his 1994 paper title. LSTM (Hochreiter & Schmidhuber 1997) builds memory a separate additive highway: the cell state C_t = f_t⊙C_{t−1} + i_t⊙g̃_t, along which backprop multiplies only by f each step, never by W again — with f≈1 the gradient rides unchanged for a hundred steps. Three gates, all σ outputs in [0,1]: the forget gate f_t multiplies the old memory elementwise, 0 wipes and 1 keeps, with bias b_f setting the default aperture — b_f=5 (σ=0.993) keeps 51% after 100 steps, the famous training trick; drag it to 0 and f=0.5 leaves only 10⁻¹² at T=40. The input gate i_t with tanh candidate g̃_t forms the write i⊙g̃ added onto the belt, turning irrelevant input away at the door; the output gate o_t controls how much h_t = o_t⊙tanh(C_t) exposes — "what to remember" and "how much to say" are separate decisions, keeping the gradient highway unpolluted. Measured on the same task (remember the subject at step 1, answer at step 40): the RNN readout is 0.01, nowhere near the 0.4 pass line, while the LSTM holds C≈0.73 and reads out 0.6; GRU merges 4 weight groups into 3 (update gate z handles write+forget, reset gate r the history), −25% parameters at comparable quality; Transformers since 2017 fetch any past step in one attention hop, but σ-valves metering flow live on in GRU/RWKV/xLSTM and every gated residual network. In essence: three learnable valves turn writing, keeping and reading of memory into flow control.) ✅ **lstm/**
- [x] MVCC & Snapshot Isolation (the locking bill is easy to compute: readers hold shared locks, writers exclusive ones, and read-read, read-write, write-write all exclude each other — a 30-second report freezes a table for 30 seconds while hundreds of updates queue. MVCC (multi-version concurrency control) takes another road: each row keeps a version chain; a write appends a new version at the head, recording its creator xmin, stamping the old version with a deleter marker xmax, prev pointing back; a read walks the chain from the head with its own snapshot and takes the first visible version — writers never block readers. A snapshot is the set of transactions active at begin; visibility asks three questions: xmin committed at or before my snapshot, xmin not in my active set, and xmax absent — or the deleter uncommitted/aborted, or committed after my snapshot. PostgreSQL stores this in the row's xmin/xmax headers; InnoDB calls it a read view. Write-write conflicts are settled by first-committer-wins: at commit, if a row you wrote was committed by a concurrent transaction, you roll back and retry — lost updates become impossible. Snapshot isolation prevents dirty and non-repeatable reads but not write skew: with the invariant "at least one doctor on call", doctor A reads B on duty and sets itself off duty, B reads A on duty and does the same — each snapshot self-consistent, write sets disjoint, both commit, nobody is on call; serializable adds SSI, tracking these "I read what you wrote" rw-antidependencies and breaking the cycle at commit by aborting the later committer. The price: every UPDATE leaves a corpse, and a long transaction pins its snapshot for hours so dead tuples cannot be reclaimed — tables and indexes bloat until PostgreSQL's VACUUM/autovacuum (InnoDB's undo log) collects them. In essence: every transaction reads its own time slice, trading space and background recycling for lock-free concurrency.) ✅ **mvcc/**
- [x] Nonstick Pans & PTFE (The secret is not oil - it is surface energy. In PTFE the C-F bond is a titan at 485 kJ/mol, and fluorine atoms sheathe the (CF2)n carbon backbone in an electrically neutral armor; the surface neither donates nor accepts electrons, so its energy is just 18-20 mN/m against water's 72 and oil's ~30 - liquids bead at a 110-120 degree contact angle because there is no surface force to grab. The pan coating is a four-layer process: grit-blasted aluminum (Ra 3-6 μm) for mechanical bite, a primer of PTFE particles in polyamide-imide resin rooted into the pits, two or three PFA/PTFE top coats, then sintering at 400 °C - past the 327 °C melting point - fusing the particles into one 20-60 μm film. The red lines are thermal: slow breakdown from 260 °C, marked at 350 °C, harmful fumes above 400 °C, and a dry empty pan crosses them all in 2-3 minutes. Hardness is only Shore D ~55, so one metal-spatula stroke starts the end; service life is 2-5 years. Ceramic sol-gel SiO2 coatings are harder (9H) but their oleophobicity is a surface modification that fades in 1-3 years. In essence: nonstick is not thickness - it is removing every surface force a liquid could hold onto.) ✅ **nonstick-pan/**
- [x] Super Glue & Cyanoacrylate (The monomer CH2=C(CN)COOR is an alkene rigged with two strong electron-withdrawing groups - cyano and ester - that pull electron density from both sides and leave the beta carbon markedly positive: an open door for nucleophiles. The trace OH- in the nanometer water film every surface carries at 40-60% RH is the initiator: it attacks the beta carbon, the double bond shifts, a carbanion forms, and anionic chain polymerization runs millisecond steps to degree of polymerization 10^3-10^4 within a second while releasing heat. Viscosity is engineered at 2-5 mPa·s, near water: wet first, then wick by capillarity into micro-roughness, curing into micro-anchor pins worth 10-20 MPa shear - thick beads cure slowly and weakly. Fingertips supply water plus amino-acid bases, initiators in bulk, so skin grabs in seconds; polyethylene, nonpolar at ~31 mN/m, neither wets nor supplies initiators and barely bonds. Weaknesses: the cured network is a brittle crosslinked glass with an ~80 °C ceiling; frosting is re-polymerized vapor; above 80% RH chains pre-polymerize short and weak, below 25% initiation starves; toughened grades load rubber microspheres, and acetone or hot alkali depolymerizes cured joints. In essence: the moisture on your finger is the initiator - one drop starts a seconds-long chain reaction.) ✅ **super-glue/**
- [x] PTC Self-Limiting Heater (BaTiO3 doped with ~0.1-0.3% La3+ on Ba2+ sites donates spare valence electrons and becomes an N-type semiconducting ceramic: room-temperature resistance of just 10-100 ohms, grains conducting while all resistance sits at grain boundaries. Below the Curie point (formulable 120-250 °C, typical 220 °C) it is tetragonal ferroelectric - spontaneous polarization cancels the boundary electron traps, the barrier is low, and heating runs at full power. Cross Tc into the cubic paraelectric phase: polarization vanishes, interface charge trapping steepens the barrier, and resistance leaps 10^3-10^6 times within a ~30 °C window - the PTC effect. The loop then closes by itself: temperature up - R up - P = V^2/R down - heating backs off; it holds Tc±5 °C with no thermostat, no thermocouple, no software, and when cooling worsens (blocked fan, dust) power throttles again, so it cannot run away into fire. The voltage-squared law gives a 220 V fan heater a near-kilowatt cold surge, then an automatic throttle-down; mosquito-repellent warmers, dryers, car cold-start and EV battery heaters share the physics. The polymer twin packs the same trick into carbon-black-loaded polyethylene: overcurrent heats it to 60-140 °C, expansion snaps the carbon chains, current stops, and cooling restores them - a self-healing fuse. Versus nichrome, whose temperature coefficient is only ~0.4%/°C (3.7x at 700 °C, no cliff, overheating policed externally). In essence: the phase change fires an invisible thermostat into the material itself.) ✅ **ptc-heater/**

### Phase 70 · Cross-Family Gap-Fill Batch 40 (14/14 complete)
- [x] Twist Drill (a standard 118° point (130-140° for hard stock, 90-100° for soft) and a ~30° helix, steeper at the rim: two lips cut together at feed f=2f_z per revolution; margins leave a 0.2-0.5 mm land to burnish and guide, web 0.125-0.25D thickening toward the shank for torque; the chisel edge at −54° to −60° rake doesn't cut, it extrudes — yet carries 40-50% of the thrust, so thinning it is the key to centering; HSS in steel runs vc≈20-30 m/min (φ10 → 800-1000 r/min), deep holes peck to break chips; asymmetric lips open the hole 0.05-0.2 mm and walk. In essence: cutting, evacuating and guiding twisted into one spiral.) ✅ **twist-drill/**
- [x] Diaphragm Pump (a flexible membrane (PTFE/Neoprene) flexes to change chamber volume: as it retreats the volume grows and pressure drops, the inlet umbrella check valve opens while the outlet shuts — suction; as it advances pressure rises, the outlet opens and the inlet closes — discharge; the media touches only membrane and valves, leak-free, so corrosives, sludge and chemicals all ride. Positive displacement, Q = stroke volume × frequency: air-operated doubles move 20-1000 L/min at 1/2-3 in, capped at 8.6 bar, self-priming 5-7 m and dry-run safe; one pump pulses ±280%, twins phased 180° cut it to ±118% plus a damper; deadhead the outlet and chamber pressure stops at supply — no over-pressure. In essence: a breathing membrane separates pumping from drive entirely.) ✅ **diaphragm-pump/**
- [x] Fractionating Column (crude is heated to 350-400 °C and partly vaporized into an atmospheric tower 6-10 m across and 30-60 m tall, trays cooling from 350 °C at the bottom to 40 °C at the top; each tray is one micro vapor-liquid equilibrium — rising vapor partly condenses through the tray liquid, tray liquid partly revaporizes — light fractions climb tray by tray, heavy ones descend, and a few dozen trays equal hundreds of simple distillations in series; carbon chain cuts the fractions: overhead gas C1-C4, gasoline 30-180 °C (C5-C10), kerosene/jet 150-250, diesel 180-360, bottoms to the vacuum tower at 5-10 kPa to drop boiling points before cracking, yielding lube, wax and asphalt; a bigger reflux ratio R buys purity with energy. In essence: column height buys distillation count, and the temperature gradient organizes itself.) ✅ **fractional-column/**
- [x] Flame Retardants (fire is a radical chain: H₂+·OH→H·+H₂O regenerates ever more active centers and concentration explodes in milliseconds; retarders rewrite the chain — halogens release HBr to intercept in the gas phase, H·+HBr→H₂+Br· and Br·+RH→HBr+R· turn branching into termination, with Sb₂O₃ synergy forming SbX₃ for double duty; phosphorus works in the condensed phase, baking phosphate glass and promoting char, phosphorus-nitrogen intumescent systems foam a char 10-50× in volume to insulate; alumina trihydrate absorbs ~1.3 kJ/g releasing water at 200-300 °C to cool and dilute. LOI decides: air holds 21% O₂ — PP 17-18 burns, PC 25, PVC 45-49 self-extinguishes, PTFE 95; UL-94 V-0 means the vertical burn dies within 10 s with no drips. In essence: positive feedback turned negative.) ✅ **flame-retardant/**
- [x] Stomach Acid & Mucus Barrier (the parietal cell's apical H⁺/K⁺-ATPase burns ATP to pump H⁺ into the lumen, K⁺ out, Cl⁻ following through channels: blood pH 7.4 becomes gastric pH 1.5-2.5 — a million-fold climb — 1-2 L of 0.1 M HCl a day; chief-cell pepsinogen activates below pH 5, optimal near 2, permanently dead above 5. The wall's own defense is the mucus-bicarbonate barrier: a 0.5 mm gel with epithelial HCO₃⁻ holds a steep gradient from pH 2 at the lumen to 6-7 at the epithelium, renewed wholesale every 3-5 days; NSAIDs block prostaglandins, cutting blood flow and mucus, and H. pylori camps in the gel with a urease ammonia cloud — ulcers are a breached wall; PPIs (omeprazole) irreversibly plug the pump. In essence: a million-fold gradient held by dynamic buffering and rapid renewal.) ✅ **stomach-acid/**
- [x] Mucociliary Escalator (airway epithelium carries ~200 cilia per cell, 6-7 μm long, beating at 10-15 Hz in two phases: a fast ~0.1 s effective stroke tips into the gel layer and drives mucus at 0.5-2 mm/s, the slow recovery hides in the ~7 μm periciliary liquid (PCL) so nothing is pushed back; neighbors phased ~0.14 cycles apart weave a metachronal wave, a million oars rowing in relay. The blanket is two-layer: MUC5AC/MUC5B gel 2-10 μm traps particles while PCL water is set by the ENaC/CFTR ion balance — below ~4 μm the cilia bend and the effective stroke fails; 10-100 mL clears in 24 h, ~1-2 cm/min in large airways. Smoking cuts beat frequency 30-50% and thickens mucus; CF's broken CFTR dehydrates the PCL — and a cough throws 100-200 km/h to save the shift. In essence: electrochemistry meters the water, a mechanical wave moves the freight.) ✅ **mucociliary-clearance/**
- [x] Magnetic Hysteresis (ferromagnets are made of domains: field H first shoves domain walls (Barkhausen's jumps, 1919), then rotates the moments at high field; B lags — the initial curve saturates at Bs≈2 T for silicon steel, H back to zero leaves remanence Br, and only −Hc zeroes it again; loop area is the loss per cycle per unit volume, scaling with frequency: silicon steel at ~1-2 W/kg and 50 Hz is the transformer-core ledger, soft magnets looping narrow at Hc 30-60 A/m; hard NdFeB loops wide — Hc≈8×10⁵ A/m, Br≈1.3 T, (BH)max 320-400 kJ/m³ — for permanence; disk media (Hc 2-4×10⁵ A/m) store bits in remanence; past iron's 770 °C Curie point thermal disorder beats exchange and the magnetism dies. In essence: surface vs wall energy, drawn as one loop.) ✅ **magnetic-hysteresis/**
- [x] Chromatic Aberration & Achromats (glass disperses: crown glass bends blue 486 nm more than red 656 nm, n_F−n_C≈0.008, Abbe number V_d=(n_d−1)/(n_F−n_C)≈64, flints 30-40; a singlet focuses blue ~1.5-2% nearer (f∝1/(n−1)) and edges fringe violet — Newton declared it incurable in refraction and built mirrors; in 1757 Dollond paired crown convex with flint concave: powers add, φ=φ₁+φ₂, while the dispersion cancel demands φ₁/V₁+φ₂/V₂=0, the negative element offsetting color at the cost of focal power — two wavelengths meet at one focus, secondary spectrum ~f/2000; an APO triplet brings the third in line; big refractors paid in length — Lick's 91 cm f/19 carries an 18 m tube; modern ED glass and fluorite (V_d≈95) keep pushing. In essence: a negative, high-dispersion lens hedges the positive one's dispersion.) ✅ **chromatic-aberration/**
- [x] EVA Spacesuit (a suit is a one-person spacecraft: cabin 101 kPa of nitrogen-oxygen air, suit ~30 kPa (4.3 psi) of pure oxygen — the small pressure difference keeps joints bendable (constant-volume bearings and bellows compensate volume) while pure O₂ holds partial pressure at ~20 kPa, sea-level grade; pre-breathe 30-60 min purges nitrogen; vacuum has no convection — +120 °C sunlit, −100 °C shadow — and the five-layer TMG (aluminized polyester + Nomex) blocks the ±150 °C swings and micrometeoroids while ~90 m of LCVG water tubing carries off 300-600 W of metabolic heat; LiOH/amine beds hold CO₂ under 0.5 kPa; the EMU weighs ~120 kg on Earth, in orbit inertia remains so you move by hand, and the SAFER pack's 24 nitrogen thrusters hold 3 m/s in reserve; exposed to vacuum, body fluids boil at 6.3 kPa and consciousness lasts 30-90 s — never hold your breath. ### Phase 68 · Cross-Family Gap-Fill Batch 38 (24/24 complete)
- [x] Radial Engine (In a radial, cylinders ring one crankshaft and only the master rod's big end rides the crank pin, with slave rods wrist-pinned to its flange, so all pistons share a single throw. The four-stroke cycle divides 720° of crank angle by the cylinder count, so a 7-cylinder radial fires every 4π/7 ≈ 102.9° in the order 1-3-5-7-2-4-6, spreading the torque pulses as evenly as possible. Even counts put opposing pistons at top dead center together and cannot fire evenly in a single row - which is why radials are always odd.) ✅ **radial-engine/**
- [x] Air Suspension (The 5-8 bar of air inside a rolling-lobe sleeve is the spring, with stiffness k = n·p_abs·A²/V: as load grows, pressure and volume rise together, stiffness climbs only gently, and k/m barely changes, holding the natural frequency at 1.2-1.5 Hz empty or full. A linkage height sensor tracks ride height, and a 300-500 W compressor charges a ~10 bar reservoir so solenoid valves fill or dump all four corners within about a second, leveling the body under load and dropping it 10-20 mm at highway speed. Steel springs, with fixed stiffness, sag into their bump stops when loaded and bounce several times before settling.) ✅ **air-suspension/**

- [x] Supercavitation (Water boils at ambient temperature when pressure drops far enough: the cavitation number σ=(p∞−pv)/(½ρv²) falls to 0.01-0.03 at 100 m/s, and a nose cavitator stretches a continuous vapor envelope up to ~10× its own diameter, swallowing the 533 mm body. Only the cavitator ring stays wet — wetted area collapses from 8.7 m² to ~0.1 m², skin friction nearly vanishes, and total drag drops by about an order of magnitude. Since natural cavitation is fragile, gas is vented in to hold the bubble, which closes through a re-entrant jet; fins must pierce the wall to steer, and Russia's Shkval rode this armor to ~100 m/s (~200 knots).) ✅ **supercavitation/**
- [x] LSM Trees & Write Amplification (The costliest thing a database does is move bytes, and a B+ tree does it randomly: every record touches a data page, its parents, sometimes a rebalance. An LSM tree appends to a write-ahead log, accumulates in a memtable, and flushes 64-256 MB at a time as sequential SSTables. Each level holds ~10x the one above, overlapping files merge down, tombstones survive until the deepest compaction, and a ~10-bit-per-key bloom filter keeps read amplification near one file per level - when compaction lags, writes stall.) ✅ **lsm-tree/**
- [x] Microphone Arrays & Beamforming (A smart speaker hears you through geometry, not expensive capsules: the target's wavefront reaches each mic τ = d·cosθ/c apart, and after delay-and-sum the signal adds ×N while incoherent noise grows only √N — a net 10·log₁₀N dB. The aperture L=(N−1)d sets the 0.89λ/L beamwidth (7 mics at d=2 cm give ~36° at 4 kHz); muting one mic drops the gain and widens the lobe, and spacing beyond λ/2 raises grating lobes that mistake interferers for targets.) ✅ **beamforming/**
- [x] The Kelly Criterion (Deal the same 60%-edge deck to bettors staking 10%, 20%, 40% and 80% of bankroll, and the paths diverge: smooth climb, fastest climb, wild swings, steady ruin. Compounding runs on the geometric mean and volatility itself charges a fee (drag ≈ σ²/2), so maximizing g(f)=p·ln(1+bf)+q·ln(1−f) gives f*=(bp−q)/b — 20% at p=0.6, b=1. The growth zero-crossing sits near 2f*, and practitioners use half-Kelly, trading a quarter of the growth for more than half the drawdown variance.) ✅ **kelly-criterion/**
- [x] Gas Stove & Flame-Failure Device (The moment soup drowns the flame, a countdown starts: the hot junction quenches, the Seebeck EMF decays with a ~15 s time constant, and within 10-30 s it slides under the ~12 mV release threshold - the proportional solenoid seats and the gas line is cut, all with no chip, powered by the flame itself. Ignition replays it backwards: hold 5-15 s until the tip passes the 20 mV holding threshold. Flow faster than flame speed lifts the flame off; slower, and it flashes back into the injector.) ✅ **gas-stove-thermocouple/**
- [x] MP3 & Psychoacoustic Coding (To the encoder, sound is not a waveform but a budget hearing before the ear: anything under the absolute threshold (sharpest at 2-4 kHz, 40-60 dB higher at the extremes) gets zero bits; a loud tone raises the masking threshold of neighboring Bark bands to within 10-25 dB of itself, and temporal masking shelters 5-20 ms before and 50-200 ms after. A 32-subband filter bank plus MDCT maps the signal to frequency, bits flow to the highest signal-to-mask ratios, and 1.411 Mbps becomes 128 kbps most listeners cannot tell from CD.) ✅ **mp3-coding/**
- [x] Train Control & ATP (Seeing the red signal and braking is replaced by a machine that watches the driver: track circuits and axle counters split the line into 1-2 km blocks, balises upload gradient and limits within 0.1 s, and CTCS-3's radio block centre streams movement authorities over GSM-R, squeezing headway to ~3 minutes - about 17.5 km between trains at 350 km/h. The ATP continuously evaluates the target-distance curve: warning at the yellow line, automatic traction cut and service braking at the orange line, emergency braking at 1.1 m/s² beyond - all developed to SIL4.) ✅ **train-control-system/**

### Phase 67 · Cross-Family Gap-Fill Batch 37 (24/24 complete)
- [x] Impact Wrench (An air motor with a planetary stage spins the hammer mechanism at 1,600-2,000 rpm. Under low load the hammer ramp-locks to the anvil and turns like a plain wrench; under high load the ramps lift it out of engagement, a spring lets it accelerate free for about half a turn, and it slams back with 10-30 J - a millisecond pulse worth 300-2,000 N·m of peak torque. The recoil is absorbed by the hammer's free spin, so the hand feels almost nothing; the price is ±20-30% preload scatter, so critical bolts still get a torque wrench.) ✅ **impact-wrench/**
- [x] Detachable Gondola (The loop rope runs at a constant 5-6 m/s, yet cabins must creep at ~0.5 m/s through the station: at entry a fixed detach rail presses the grip lever, the clamp jaws open and the cabin drops onto the tire conveyor; at exit an attach rail clamps it back onto the rope, spring preload plus wedge self-lock giving 20-30 kN of grip. The ø3.5-4.5 m bullwheel drives over a 180° wrap under the friction limit E=e^{μα}, with hydraulic tensioning holding 100-300 kN; cabins hang plumb and the line climbs up to ~45°.) ✅ **detachable-gondola/**
- [x] Common-Rail Injection (In-line pump pressure rises and falls with rpm, so idle sprays coarse and smoky. A common-rail system lets the plunger pump (~2 cm³/rev) simply feed the rail, with the ECU holding 1,800-2,500 bar through a closed-loop regulator - pressure is decoupled from speed and idle still sees 2,000 bar. Each shot energizes the solenoid for 0.1-0.5 ms, lifting the needle ~0.2 mm; diesel blasts through 5-8 holes of ø0.10-0.15 mm into 5-10 μm droplets, one combustion split into pilot-main-post (3-5 segments), with quantity fixed by rail pressure × pulse width at ±1% repeatability.) ✅ **common-rail-injection/**
- [x] Indigo Vat Dyeing (Indigo's conjugated chromophores absorb orange-red light and thus look blue, but the molecule is insoluble - dipped directly it merely sits on the fiber surface. Vat dyeing first reduces indigo in pH 11-13 alkali with a reductant (fermentation or sodium dithionite Na₂S₂O₄) into soluble leuco-indigo that cotton fibers absorb; on lifting, dissolved oxygen oxidizes it back within 1-2 minutes - yellow to green to blue on the spot, precipitated inside the fiber, which is why it never washes out. Oxidation without re-reduction deepens one shade per dip; jeans take 8-12 dips.) ✅ **indigo-vat-dye/**
- [x] Hydrogen Embrittlement (Pickling, plating, cathodic protection and H₂S service all charge high-strength steel (>1,000 MPa class) with hydrogen: the tiny atoms diffuse at ~10⁻⁹ cm²/s at room temperature and, riding grain-boundary fast paths, saturate a bolt within days. Segregating at thread roots and inclusions they either localize plasticity (HELP) or weaken bonds (HEDE), turning dimple fractures brittle-intergranular and collapsing elongation by more than half; worse, under static loads well within strength a crack creeps for hours to years, then snaps without warning. Fixes: bake 190-210 °C for 4-24 h after plating, de-rated strength classes, low-charging coatings.) ✅ **hydrogen-embrittlement/**
- [x] Zone Refining (Most impurities have segregation coefficient k=C_s/C_l<1 - they prefer staying molten, so the freezing interface sieves them out of the solid. An induction coil melts a narrow zone and sweeps it head-to-tail at mm/min speed: every re-melt-freeze drives impurities into the melt until they pile up in a tail that is sawn off. One pass drops head impurity like e^{−kx/ℓ} and n passes improve it exponentially; the Ge/Si era reached 99.9999999% (9N) with 6-10 passes. Today the Siemens process handles industrial silicon while zone refining owns extreme-purity niches like detectors and infrared optics.) ✅ **zone-refining/**
- [x] Phototransduction (In darkness cGMP holds the outer-segment cation channels open: a 30-100 pA dark current flows and glutamate is released continuously. One photon turns rhodopsin into active Meta II, which activates ~800 transducins in sequence, each recruiting a PDE6 — a 10⁵-10⁶ cascade. PDE hydrolyzes cGMP, channels close in droves, ~1 pA is shaved off (~20 ms peak delay), and the hyperpolarized cell releases less glutamate, freeing ON bipolar cells; RGS9 shuts the cascade off, calcium feedback rebuilds cGMP, and adaptation spans ~10⁷.) ✅ **phototransduction/**
- [x] Capsaicin & TRPV1 (TRPV1 guards the 43 °C gate on sensory endings; capsaicin binds the S512/Y511 pocket with K_D≈0.4 μM, and either gate open lets Ca²⁺/Na⁺ flood in and drive firing to ~28 Hz — the brain reads hot plus painful though the skin never warmed, so spice is pain, not taste. Pungency is measured in dilutions: bell pepper 0, jalapeño ~5,000, ghost pepper ~1,000,000, Pepper X ~2,700,000 SHU; sustained binding triggers calcium-dependent desensitization (dephosphorylation plus endocytosis), exploited by capsaicin pain creams, while milk casein strips the lipophilic capsaicin away where water cannot.) ✅ **trpv1-capsaicin/**
- [x] Parturition & Oxytocin (Fetal HPA-axis cortisol starts labor: the placenta flips toward estrogen, prostaglandins rise, the cervix ripens. The head pressing the cervix fires the Ferguson reflex — mechanoreceptors climb to the hypothalamus, the posterior pituitary pulses oxytocin, and receptor upregulation of 100-200-fold leaves the positive feedback brakeless: intervals tighten from ~10 min to 2-3 min, pressure reaches 50-60 mmHg, and full 10 cm dilation takes first-time mothers 6-18 h plus a 0.5-2 h second stage. Birth removes the stretch and unlocks the loop; postpartum oxytocin clamps the uterus against hemorrhage and fires milk ejection, and induction (1-20 mU/min IV) simply pumps the loop from outside.) ✅ **parturition/**
- [x] Synchrotron Radiation (3-6 GeV electrons (γ~10⁴) bend under the Lorentz force while relativistic aberration funnels the radiation into a tangent cone of half-angle 1/γ≈0.1 mrad — a searchlight lighting each beamline once per lap. The broadband spectrum peaks at E_c=0.665·E²·B: ~7 keV at 3 GeV and 1.2 T, ~29 keV at 6 GeV; undulator fields make photons interfere on axis, adding 10⁸-10¹⁰ in brilliance over a bending magnet; the U0=88.5·E⁴/ρ loss per lap (0.9-7 MeV) is repaid turn by turn by RF cavities. Brilliance ~10²⁰ ph/s/mm²/mrad²/0.1%BW — about 10⁹ the Sun's surface — powers protein crystallography, absorption spectroscopy and DUV lithography.) ✅ **synchrotron-radiation/**
- [x] Parity Violation & the Wu Experiment (A parity transformation mirrors the world and was assumed universal before 1956; θ (two pions, positive parity) and τ (three pions, negative) share mass, charge and lifetime, so Lee and Yang noted weak decays had never been mirror-tested. Wu Chien-Shiung cooled ⁶⁰Co to ~0.003 K and magnetized the spins: at ~60% polarization the along/against-spin counts came out about 2:8, electrons preferring left-handed anti-spin emission — the mirror-image process does not exist in nature and parity is maximally violated; CP fell in 1964 with K mesons, possibly tied to the cosmic matter surplus, and atomic parity violation in cesium and thallium has been measured precisely since 1997.) ✅ **parity-violation/**
- [x] Green Flash & Atmospheric Refraction (Horizon sunlight is lifted ~0.5° (34′) by refraction: when the lower limb touches the sea the Sun is already geometrically set and sunset runs ~2 minutes late; blue bends ~1% more than red, stacking the Sun into disks with blue above red and a true red-green split of only 20-30″. The long slant path scatters blue away (Rayleigh ∝1/λ⁴), leaving cyan-green as the surviving top layer — at sunset the colors exit in order and the last 1-2 s show only the green rim: real dispersion, not an illusion. A cold-over-warm inversion ducts the rays into a green pillar; high-latitude ducted flashes can last past ten seconds, demanding a sharp sea horizon and clean air.) ✅ **green-flash/**
- [x] The Helium Flash (The Helium Flash & Degenerate Runaway (A red giant's ~0.45 M☉ helium core hangs on electron degeneracy: P=Kρ^{5/3} ignores temperature, so added heat never expands or cools it and the stellar thermostat fails. Triple-alpha burns at ε₃α∝ρ²Y³·exp(−44/T₈); from T₈=1.0 to 2.0 the rate jumps ~3.6×10⁹×, releasing ~10⁴¹ J at ~10¹⁰ L☉ within minutes - nearly all swallowed by envelope expansion work, perturbing the surface luminosity by only ~10%, invisible from outside. The flash lifts degeneracy, the core swells back into an ideal gas, and the star settles onto the horizontal branch burning helium quietly for ~100 Myr; the Sun will live this in ~7.6 Gyr.)) ✅ **helium-flash/**
- [x] Sun-Synchronous Orbit (Earth's equatorial bulge (J₂≈1.083×10⁻³) torques inclined orbits into nodal precession at dΩ/dt=−(3/2)nJ₂(Re/p)²cosi. Choosing inclination 97-99° at 600-800 km makes precession exactly +0.9856°/day, canceling the Sun's apparent motion: the plane locks onto the Sun, every pass crosses at the same local time (e.g. 10:30) with steady lighting and power. A plain polar orbit (i=90°) never precesses and drifts 12 hours against the Sun in half a year.) ✅ **sun-synchronous-orbit/**
- [x] Coronagraph Imaging (Direct imaging faces a double wall: planets are 10⁸-10⁹ times fainter than their stars, and diffraction spreads starlight into an Airy pattern (first null at 1.22λ/D) right over the planet's position. A coronagraph suppresses starlight with a focal-plane mask plus a pupil Lyot stop, while a deformable mirror interferes the residual into a 'dark hole' at contrast 10⁻⁸-10⁻¹⁰; a planet shows up once F_p/F_★>C. HR 8799's four giants (17-68 AU) were thus made into an orbital movie measuring spin and weather.) ✅ **coronagraph-imaging/**
- [x] The Tea-Leaf Paradox (Stirring spins the cup water nearly rigidly, raising pressure radially outward - wall over center by Δp=½ρΩ²R² (≈58 Pa at 1.2 rev/s). In the bottom Ekman layer (δ≈0.5-1 mm) the spin collapses, so the centrifugal balance fails while the pressure gap persists: the bottom layer is squeezed toward the axis, then rises at the center, flows outward at the surface and sinks along the wall - a closed secondary circulation that escorts the leaves to the middle. Einstein (1926) showed river bends run on the same physics: surface flow scours the concave bank while bottom flow builds the convex bar.) ✅ **tea-leaf-paradox/**
- [x] The Janssen Effect (A liquid carries no shear, so hydrostatic pressure p=ρgh grows linearly with depth; a granular column shunts its weight sideways into the walls through force chains, and vertical pressure saturates exponentially per Janssen: p=ρ_b·g·λ(1−e^{−z/λ}) with λ=R/(2μK)≈1.4 m. Hence bottom pressures of a 2 m and a 20 m silo are nearly the same (about 8.3 vs 10.9 kPa) while water would give 19.6 vs 196 kPa, and ~93% of a 20 m fill hangs on the walls. During discharge dynamic pressure overshoots static by 20-30%; grains can also arch over the outlet and jam the flow.) ✅ **janssen-effect/**
- [x] The Coffee-Ring Effect (Roughness pins a droplet's contact line: as it evaporates the radius R stays fixed and the drop only flattens. Vapor escapes through a wider cone at the rim, so the local flux J(r)∝(R−r)^{−1/2} diverges at the edge - already 3.2x the center at r=0.9R; to make up the loss, an internal capillary flow from center to edge convays particles to the contact line, where they deposit into a dark coffee ring. De-pinning, surfactants or Marangoni recirculation make the deposit uniform - inkjet formulations are built to fight exactly this.) ✅ **coffee-ring-effect/**
- [x] Monte Carlo Tree Search (Minimax dies on Go: ~250 legal moves per turn over 150+ moves gives a ~10^360 game tree, and hand-written evaluations are hopeless too. MCTS replaces scoring with playing: each round selects a branch by UCT=Q/N+C·√(ln N_parent/N_i) with C≈1-1.7, expands one child, simulates randomly to a terminal state, and backs the result up the path. Winning branches get revisited and thicken, so compute concentrates on the critical lines - tens of thousands of playouts reach amateur strength on 9x9.) ✅ **monte-carlo-tree-search/**
- [x] The TLS Handshake (Plaintext HTTP can be sniffed, tampered with and spoofed, so TLS handshakes before any data flows. TLS 1.3 compresses this into one round trip: the client sends a 32-byte random, cipher suites and an X25519 ephemeral key share; the server answers with its certificate chain and key share, the browser verifies each signature with the issuer's public key (RSA-2048 / ECDSA P-256), checks domain, validity and revocation, and anchors the chain in the built-in trust store. Both sides then compute the same session keys via ECDHE and HKDF over the transcript - ephemeral keys are fresh per connection, so a future server-key leak cannot decrypt past traffic (forward secrecy). Finished HMACs the entire handshake, so any MITM tampering fails on the spot. TLS 1.2's RSA key transport (2-RTT, no forward secrecy) is retired.) ✅ **tls-handshake/**
- [x] Priority Inversion (Three tasks sharing one mutex plant a mine: L (low) holds the lock in its critical section, H (high) turns ready but stalls on the lock, and M (medium) needs no lock yet keeps preempting L by priority - the lowest-priority task ends up hijacking the highest one. That is priority inversion. Mars Pathfinder kept resetting its bus on Mars in 1997: the weather task (low, lock holder) blocked the comms task (high) while the bus manager (medium) preempted, and the ground team fixed it by remotely enabling priority inheritance in VxWorks. Inheritance raises L to H's priority while it holds the lock - in the default script H's wait drops from 4.2 s to 2.2 s and 5 preemptions become 0. The ceiling protocol instead runs the holder at the critical section's highest priority and blocks deadlock as a bonus; the price is that critical sections must be designed short.) ✅ **priority-inversion/**
- [x] The Moka Pot (The moka pot's driving force is not steam but pressure difference: water sealed in the lower chamber heats until vapor pressure reaches ~1-1.5 bar and pushes the whole column up the central tube - like a piston - through ~15-20 g of medium-fine, un-tamped coffee into the top chamber; the steam itself barely passes the bed. Brew water runs ~90-100 °C, slightly above pour-over (90-94 °C), at pressures two orders of magnitude below espresso (9 bar, 92-95 °C). Grinding too fine or tamping chokes the bed and pressure races toward ~2.5 bar, popping the safety valve; too much flame blasts through under-extracted with metallic notes. The craft: medium-low heat, cut the fire when the brew turns honey-colored - the gurgle (a steam-water mix) is the timer - then cool the base to stop extraction. Invented by Alfonso Bialetti in 1933; about 90% of Italian households own one.) ✅ **moka-pot/**
- [x] Tempered Glass and the Safety Hammer (Tempering is pre-stressed armor for glass: heat to ~620-650 °C, blast both faces with high-pressure air; the surface hardens and freezes first, and as the interior keeps shrinking it presses the surface into ~100-150 MPa residual compression balanced by core tension. A crack must first pay off that compression, so bending strength reaches 4-5× annealed glass and thermal-shock tolerance ~200-300 °C. But the tensioned core stores huge elastic energy: once a tungsten-carbide hammer tip pushes local surface stress past the limit, cracks race across at km/s scale and the pane disintegrates into 2-5 mm blunt granules with no long blades. Spontaneous breakage usually traces to NiS inclusions expanding at phase change, screened by ~290 °C heat-soak testing (HST). Tempered glass cannot be cut afterwards, and windshields use laminated PVB instead so they 'crack but hold'.) ✅ **tempered-glass/**
- [x] The Cross-Belt Sorter (A cross-belt sorter runs sorting as a triple beat: before the loop, every parcel passes the DWS gantry - dynamic weighing, laser dimensioning, six-face scanning - and the system maps it to one of ~200-400 chutes; carts cruise the loop at ~2-2.5 m/s, receive the dispatch command ~1 m (belt spin-up time × speed) before the target chute, and an independent mini-belt perpendicular to the track flings the parcel sideways in. One line moves 10-20k parcels per hour, about one per metre-second, with mis-sort rates under 0.1% backed by cross-checks between barcode, volume and weight; parcels that fail scanning, oversize, find a full chute or a late command land in the reject port for manual handling. The command lead is a hard deadline - half a second late and the parcel sails past its chute.) ✅ **cross-belt-sorter/**

### Phase 66 · Cross-Family Gap-Fill Batch 36 (24/24 complete)
- [x] Axial Piston Pump & the Swashplate (Rotate the cylinder block and each of 7 pistons strokes once along the swashplate: s=D·tanβ, half a turn suction, half discharge — the port plate's kidney slots are a rotary valve. Displacement V=Z·(π/4)d²·D·tanβ with β stepless 0-18°: pressure compensation trims flow on demand for constant-power 250-400 bar; odd piston count keeps ripple ~2.5%, and a center orifice oils each slipper pad.) ✅ **axial-piston-pump/**
- [x] Rotor Balancing & Correction Weights (10 g of eccentric mass at 6,000 rpm flings out 197 N — F=mrω², rising with the square of speed. Static unbalance gives a 1× force; dynamic adds a couple that bows the rotor. Two correction planes sum counterweights against the unbalance vectors, grade G=e·ω sets the allowed eccentricity (G2.5 at 10,000 rpm: 2.4 μm), and the influence-coefficient field method computes the fix from one trial weight: α=(A1−A0)/T.) ✅ **rotor-balancing/**
- [x] Crumple Zones & Crash Energy (A 1.5 t car at 56 km/h carries ~182 kJ of kinetic energy that deformation must eat within 0.6-0.8 m: F·s=ΔE — 300 kN average force means ~20 g; halve the stroke and force doubles. The nose is "soft" (crush boxes plus crash-guided rails), the cell "hard" (1,500 MPa hot-stamped steel); a tall, flat force-stroke curve with corrugated folds absorbs 2-3× more than random buckling; pretensioner, load limiter and airbag run a 60-100 ms relay.) ✅ **crumple-zone/**

- [x] Pressure Swing Adsorption & Carbon Molecular Sieves (O₂ (3.46 Å) is a hair smaller than N₂ (3.64 Å); the ~3.5 Å pore mouths of carbon molecular sieve let O₂ diffuse ~30× faster — inside a short adsorption window O₂ is swallowed and N₂ passes as product. Twin beds cycle charge-adsorb-equalize-blowdown 180° out of phase; equalization hands dead-space pressure over, for 35-50% recovery at 99-99.9%. Oxygen uses LiX zeolite (equilibrium separation). Capex 1/5-1/10 of cryogenic, minutes to start.) ✅ **psa-gas-separation/**

In the bell-jar reactor, U-rod silicon cores run ~1100 °C and SiHCl₃+H₂ deposits on the hot surface, growing φ120-200 mm rods in 100-150 h; byproduct SiCl₄ is hydrogenated back in a closed loop. Power, 50-60 kWh/kg, dominates; fluidized-bed pellets halve it at a purity cost.) ✅ **siemens-polysilicon/**
- [x] Optogenetics & Channelrhodopsin (Electricity can't target cell types; drugs can't work in milliseconds. AAV vectors with cell-type promoters decide who gets lit; fibers reach freely moving animals; yellow-light NpHR/ArchT brake in the opposite direction. Lasker 2021; retinal prostheses in trials.) ✅ **optogenetics/**
- [x] X-Inactivation & the Calico Cat (XX vs XY doubles the dose. Lyon (1961): early in the embryo every cell rolls dice and silences one X — XIST lncRNA blankets the chromosome into a Barr body, the choice made at the few-thousand-cell stage and inherited by all descendants; the adult female is a mosaic of two clones, and a calico cat's orange-black patches are a literal map of X inactivation. ~15-25% of genes (PAR especially) escape — the compensation is imperfect.) ✅ **x-inactivation/**
- [x] The Rumen & Microbial Fiber Fermentation (Cows have no cellulase; the rumen — a 100-150 L fermenter holding 10¹⁰-10¹¹ microbes per mL — turns grass into acetic (60-65%), propionic (20-25%) and butyric acids (15-20%), with propionic acid feeding gluconeogenesis for nearly all blood glucose. Methanogens convert fermentation hydrogen into 200-500 L of burped CH₄ a day; saliva buffers 100-200 L daily and rumination chews fiber 6-8 h. Push the concentrate and pH falls below 5.5 — lactic acid, and acidosis.) ✅ **rumen-fermentation/**
- [x] Muon Tomography & Pyramid X-Rays (Cosmic rays breed muons in the atmosphere: proper lifetime 2.2 μs, yet GeV time dilation carries them through 10 km of air — ~10,000 per m² per minute at sea level. 10-100 GeV muons pierce 1-10 m of rock; directional flux loss is a density projection — a free, deep-penetrating X-ray. In 2017 three independent detectors found the ~30 m "Big Void" in Khufu's pyramid; scattering tomography now locates fuel debris at Fukushima.) ✅ **muon-tomography/**
- [x] Ring Laser Gyro & the Sagnac Effect (On a rotating turntable the clockwise and counter-clockwise beams travel different paths: the ring laser cavity splits resonance by Δf=4A·Ω/(λP) — with A=100 cm², P=60 cm, 633 nm that is 0.51 Hz per °/h; Earth's spin alone reads 7.6 Hz. At low rates backscattering locks the modes into a dead band; mechanical dither (~400 Hz) restores linearity. Three orthogonal rings are the heart of a strapdown INS with 0.001-0.01°/h drift.) ✅ **ring-laser-gyro/**
- [x] Dilution Refrigerator & the Millikelvin (A qubit needs kT ≪ hν (4-8 GHz is 16-33 μeV); at 10 mK, kT is just 0.86 μeV. The only continuous millikelvin refrigerator exploits ³He/⁴He phase separation below 0.87 K: pumping the dilute phase makes concentrated ³He cross the interface — an evaporation surface that costs enthalpy and cools. Still at 0.7 K, mixing chamber at 10-20 mK, pulse-tube precool to 4 K, attenuators and heat anchors guard every microwatt.) ✅ **dilution-refrigerator/**
- [x] Fast Radio Bursts & Magnetar Flares (A few milliseconds can outshine the Sun for days: the first FRB surfaced in 2007 archival data with DM 375 pc/cm³ — low frequencies arrive late, sweeping a rainbow. Δt∝DM/ν² makes interstellar electrons a distance gauge, most of the DM from intergalactic space. In 2020 the Galactic magnetar SGR 1935+2154 fired FRB 200428 — magnetars are one source confirmed. CHIME catches several a day; the all-sky rate is 10³-10⁴, and the engine is still debated.) ✅ **fast-radio-burst/**
- [x] The Heliosphere & the Edge of the Solar System (The solar wind (400-800 km/s) blows a plasma bubble: the termination shock subsonics it at 80-100 AU, and the heliopause at ~120 AU balances interstellar pressure. Voyager 1 crossed in 2012 (121.6 AU), Voyager 2 in 2018 (119 AU), catching the electron-density jump and the surge of galactic cosmic rays. The 11-year solar cycle makes the bubble breathe, and IBEX's neutral-atom portrait hints at a croissant, not a comet tail.) ✅ **heliopause/**
- [x] Crater Counting & Surface Dating (Age without samples: the density of craters ≥D per area grows with exposure time, and overlaying a counted N(D)-D curve on isochrons dates the surface. Apollo samples pin the scale (lunar maria 3.5-4.0 Gyr). Three traps: saturation caps ancient surfaces, secondaries pose as primaries, and weathering or volcanism erases small craters. Pluto's Sputnik Planitia has none at all: younger than 10 Myr.) ✅ **crater-chronology/**
- [x] Shock Diamonds & Underexpanded Jets (With exit pressure above ambient, the jet fans out through Prandtl-Meyer expansion, then ambient pressure squeezes it back through oblique shocks — stretch and squeeze repeat as diamonds. In strong underexpansion a normal shock stands up midstream: the Mach disk, ~0.36D√(pₑ/pₐ) across. Cell spacing L≈1.3D√(p₀/pₐ) — count the diamonds, read the pressure ratio. The bright blue between cells is afterburning in the shear layer; the price is kHz screech and lost thrust.) ✅ **shock-diamonds/**
- [x] Rogue Waves & Focusing (On New Year's Day 1995 the Draupner platform measured a single 25.6 m wave — 2.1× the 12 m sea state — turning sailor lore into instrument record. A rogue wave exceeds 2×Hs; Gaussian seas predict odds of ~10⁻¹⁵, yet the ocean delivers: long waves overtake short ones in phase, currents and banks act as lenses, and Benjamin-Feir modulation instability grows Peregrine breathers three times the background. Satellite altimetry counts thousands a year in open water.) ✅ **rogue-waves/**
- [x] Rotor Flapping & Retreating Blade Stall (In forward flight the advancing blade sees 200+ m/s while the retreating one sees a fraction — lift differs several-fold and a rigid rotor flips. The flapping hinge lets blades breathe: advancing rises, cutting its angle of attack; retreating droops, raising its own — feedback that levels lift, delayed 90° by precession, which cyclic pitch anticipates. Push faster and the retreating side passes ~12-15° into stall: the helicopter's 280-330 km/h ceiling, eased by swept tips and compound propulsion.) ✅ **rotor-flapping/**
- [x] Out-of-Order Execution & Register Renaming (Pipelines hate waiting. RAW dependencies are real, but WAR/WAW are fake — artifacts of 16/32 architectural names. Tomasulo (1967) added reservation stations and renaming that map each result onto 180-300 physical registers; instructions fire out of order the moment operands land. The ROB retires them in program order with precise exceptions. IPC climbs from 0.9 to 2-4; the bill is Spectre — transient computation leaves secrets in cache.) ✅ **out-of-order-execution/**
- [x] Boosting & Sequential Error Correction (Random forests cut variance in parallel; boosting cuts bias in series. AdaBoost up-weights mistakes, with learner say α_t=½ln((1−ε_t)/ε_t); gradient boosting fits residuals outright, nudging with learning rate ν 0.05-0.1 and shallow trees of depth 3-8 — XGBoost adds second-order Taylor terms and regularization. On tabular data GBDTs still routinely beat neural nets, with feature importance for free.) ✅ **boosting-ensemble/**
- [x] Shamir Secret Sharing & Threshold Reconstruction (One keyholder is a single point of failure; n copies are n attack surfaces. Shamir (1979) hides the secret S as the constant term of a degree t−1 polynomial and hands out one point each. Any t points restore f(0) by Lagrange interpolation; t−1 points leak zero information — every secret equally likely, no computational assumptions. Homomorphic addition and verifiable dealing come free; nuclear triggers, HSM roots and SLIP-39 rely on it.) ✅ **shamir-secret-sharing/**
- [x] Vinyl Records & the Stylus Groove (One spiral V-groove (90°, ~25 μm deep) carries stereo: left and right channels are cut into the two 45° walls, resolved by the stylus's horizontal wiggle. At 33⅓ rpm the linear speed falls from 50 cm/s outside to 20 cm/s inside — shorter wavelengths, more tracing distortion; the inner-groove penalty is geometry. Cutting attenuates lows ~20 dB and boosts highs; RIAA equalization reverses it on playback. Dynamic range 60-70 dB versus CD's 96 — but continuous, analog warmth.) ✅ **vinyl-record/**
- [x] Base Isolation & Lead-Rubber Bearings (Bracing hard makes the building shake worse — resonance amplifies floor motion 2-4×. Isolation changes the game: a flexible layer under the structure stretches the period from 0.3-0.5 s to 2-3 s, out of the earthquake's energy band, so the superstructure rides nearly rigid — accelerations cut to 1/3-1/5. An LRB stacks rubber for vertical load (500-8,000 t per bearing) around a lead core that yields to dissipate (15-25% damping); 300-500 mm of drift lands in the isolation layer. Northridge 1994: 0.49 g outside, 0.13 g inside the isolated hospital.) ✅ **base-isolation/**
- [x] Hemodialysis & the Semipermeable Membrane (When the kidneys stop, urea, creatinine and potassium need a stand-in. Inside the dialyzer, 10-15 thousand hollow fibers (200 μm bore, 1.5-2 m² total) carry blood against a counterflowing dialysate — countercurrent keeps the concentration gradient alive end to end; co-current exhausts it. Diffusion clears small solutes, ultrafiltration removes 1-4 L of water, and dialysate K at 1-3 mmol/L pulls potassium down. Three 4-hour sessions a week at Kt/V≥1.2; clearing too fast swells the brain — dialysis disequilibrium teaches patience.) ✅ **hemodialysis/**

### Phase 64 · Cross-Family Gap-Fill Batch 35 (25/25 complete)
- [x] Mecanum Wheels & Omnidirectional Drive (Ten barrel rollers at 45° to each axle push the ground reaction obliquely: v_x=R/4·Σω (forward), v_y=R/4(−ω₁+ω₂−ω₃+ω₄) (strafe), ω_z from diagonal differences; at 45° fore/aft and lateral ability are equal (cosβ=sinβ). Strafe = mirror spin, spin-in-place = diagonal pairs, circle = all three at once — ordinary wheels only push fore-aft, and AGVs owe their three DOF to this ring of slanted rollers.) ✅ **mecanum-wheels/**
- [x] Peristaltic Pump & Valve-Free Pumping (Rotating rollers squeeze a silicone tube fully shut and carry trapped slugs mechanically: Q=V_slug×rollers×rpm (6.4 mm bore, ~30 mm crushed length → 0.96 mL/slug; 3 rollers at 100 rpm ≈ 290 mL/min). Behind each roller the tube rebounds and sucks back against drips. Fluid touches only the tube — sterile, choke-proof, self-priming — at the price of pulsation and tube fatigue; ±0.5-2% accuracy.) ✅ **peristaltic-pump/**
- [x] Camshaft & Valve Timing (A cam is a shape compiled into steel: the nose turns rotation into an exact lift-vs-timing program — ~9-11 mm lift, ~230-270° duration, ~40-60° intake/exhaust overlap at TDC; crank twice per cam. Long duration breathes at high rpm but idles rough (VE collapses); hydraulic lifters erase the 0.1-0.25 mm cold clearance; springs preload 200-300 N until valve float.) ✅ **valvetrain/**
- [x] Two-Stroke Engine & Crankcase Scavenging (The piston is its own slide valve: descending it opens exhaust (~70° BBDC) then transfer ports, and crankcase-compressed charge (~1.3) loops up in a Schnürle curl to shove exhaust out — gas exchange takes just ~120° of crank. One power stroke per revolution gives 60-80% higher power density, but short-circuiting costs 20-40% more fuel: the price chainsaws and mopeds pay.) ✅ **two-stroke-engine/**
- [x] The Steam Catapult (Accumulators bank boiler steam at ~30-45 bar; the launch valve snaps full-open in milliseconds and a piston in the ~90 m cylinder drags the aircraft to 70-97 m/s (250-350 km/h, 3-4 g) in 2-3 s: a=ηpA/m, set by steam pressure and weight (20-32 t) — fall short of end speed and you go into the sea. The launch bar drops and the holdback releases on cue; a water brake swallows ~9 MJ and resets; ~600 kg of steam per shot.) ✅ **steam-catapult/**
- [x] Cryogenic Air Separation & the Double Column (Air is 78.1% N₂ (bp 77.4 K), 20.9% O₂ (90.2 K), 0.93% Ar (87.3 K) — a 12.8 K spread resolved by distillation: compress to 5-6 bar, strip H₂O/CO₂ on sieves, pre-cool to ~100 K recovering >95% cold, and expand (η 80-85%) rather than throttle. The HP column (5-6 bar) sits under the LP column (1.3-1.5 bar) with one block doing two jobs — HP-top N₂ condenses = LP-bottom O₂-rich liquid boils. 99.5% O₂, 99.999% N₂, 0.35-0.5 kWh/kg O₂.) ✅ **air-separation/**
- [x] Urea Synthesis & the Carbamate Loop (2NH₃+CO₂→ammonium carbamate is fast and exothermic (ΔH≈−117 kJ/mol); carbamate dehydration to urea is slow and reversible — at 180-200 °C, 150-250 bar one pass converts only ~55-70%. CO₂ stripping drives unreacted NH₃ out, the HP condenser sends it back, and the closed loop lifts total yield to ~98%. Each tonne of urea fixes 0.735 t of CO₂; ~180 Mt/yr, two-thirds to fertilizer, and the 32.5% solution is AdBlue.) ✅ **urea-synthesis/**
- [x] Methanol Synthesis & C1 Chemistry (CO+2H₂⇌CH₃OH (ΔH=−90.7 kJ/mol) runs over Cu/ZnO/Al₂O₃ at 200-300 °C, 50-100 bar: exothermic with half the moles, so low T and high P favor equilibrium — but kinetics crawl when cold, so ~250 °C splits the difference. Per-pass conversion is 5-15%, recycled past 99%, with boiling water removing heat. Coal syngas (CO-rich) and green methanol (CO₂+H₂, module (H₂−CO₂)/(CO+CO₂)≈2.05) feed the same reactor.) ✅ **methanol-synthesis/**
- [x] Snake Scales & Four Gaits (Overlapping belly scales make backward sliding 1.5-2× harder than forward — a one-way ratchet. Lateral undulation braces against pegs and rocks (on a slick floor thrust collapses — the corn-snake peg experiment); concertina anchors and reaches in burrows; rectilinear rolls belly scales in waves for big slow snakes; sidewinding keeps 2-3 contact patches to cheat 60 °C sand. Speeds: 1-2 body lengths/s undulating, 0.3-0.7 sidewinding.) ✅ **snake-locomotion/**
- [x] Spider Silk & Superfibers (Dragline silk pairs nano-crystals (β-sheet crystallites ~10 nm) for strength with an amorphous phase for stretch: ~1.0-1.3 GPa tensile (mild steel ~0.4), 30-40% elongation (Kevlar <4%), toughness ~160 MJ/m³ (Kevlar ~50, steel ~6). Capture-spiral glue droplets are windlasses that pay out inner thread to cushion impact; wet supercontraction shrinks it 30-50% to re-tension the web; a 2 μm fiber lifts 2 g.) ✅ **spider-silk/**
- [x] Bird Air Sacs & Unidirectional Flow (Air sacs hold 2-3× the lung volume but exchange no gas — they are bellows. Two breaths, four phases: inhale 1 fills posterior sacs, exhale 1 drives it through the parabronchi, inhale 2 moves lung air to anterior sacs, exhale 2 vents it. Flow through the lung is one-way in both phases, while mammals flush a dead-end tidal lung with only ~1/3 of each breath reaching exchange tissue; flight demands 10-20× resting O₂, and bar-headed geese still flap at 6,000+ m.) ✅ **bird-respiration/**
- [x] Bacterial Quorum Sensing (Every cell secretes AHL that diffuses freely across the membrane; concentration scales with density, so the signal is a headcount. Cross the threshold (~1-10 μM; Vibrio fischeri hits it at ~10¹¹ cells/mL in the squid light organ) and LuxR saturates, the lux operon switches on everywhere at once — bioluminescence, with luxI positive feedback making it a switch, not a dial. Biofilm maturation, virulence and competence ride the same channel; quorum-quenching enzymes degrade AHL and steal the language.) ✅ **quorum-sensing/**
- [x] Tree Rings & Dendrochronology (The cambium lays down one ring a year: wide pale earlywood, narrow dark latewood, width recording that year's water and heat. Marker narrow rings from droughts match across trees, so cores cross-date back into the calendar — European oak-pine chronologies reach ~12,000 years, and they are the backbone of the radiocarbon calibration curve; the oldest living bristlecone is ~4,850 years.) ✅ **tree-rings/**
- [x] Metronome Synchronization & Coupled Oscillators (Metronomes with slightly different frequencies sit on a platform that can roll: each pendulum shoves the platform, and the platform's acceleration feeds back to every pendulum — coupling that reels the frequency spread in. Kuramoto: dθᵢ/dt=ωᵢ+(K/N)Σsin(θⱼ−θᵢ); critical coupling K_c≈2σ — below it phases stay scattered, above it the order parameter r climbs to 1. In-phase and anti-phase (Huygens, 1665) are both stable; grid frequency, firefly flashes and the Millennium Bridge share the math.) ✅ **metronome-sync/**
- [x] Solitons & the KdV Balance (In 1834 Russell watched a single hump run miles down a canal: dispersion spreads a wave packet while nonlinearity steepens crests, and the KdV balance u_t+6uu_x+u_xxx=0 locks the shape into a sech² soliton — width ∝1/√A, speed ∝(1+A/3)c₀ with c₀=√(gh). A tall soliton overtakes a short one and both emerge intact, shifted only in phase (Zabusky-Kruskal 1965). A tsunami, being a linear long wave, is not one.) ✅ **soliton/**
- [x] Optical Tweezers & the Gradient Force (Light carries momentum, and refraction kicks an equal-and-opposite recoil onto a bead: a uniform beam only pushes (scattering force), but a focused beam adds a gradient force pulling the bead toward peak intensity, with the axial trap just past focus (~λ/2). Stiffness ~0.01-0.1 pN/nm, forces 1-100 pN — enough to hold a cell without harm (Ashkin, Nobel 2018). Brownian jitter reads as a thermometer; drag a kinesin and resolve its 8 nm steps.) ✅ **optical-tweezers/**
- [x] Second-Harmonic Generation & Phase Matching (Under intense light the medium stops being a linear spring: P=ε₀(χ⁽¹⁾E+χ⁽²⁾E²+…) hides a 2ω term in E² — forbidden (χ⁽²⁾=0) in centrosymmetric crystals, allowed in KTP/KDP/BBO. To grow along the crystal the harmonics must stay in step (Δk=2k_ω−k_2ω=0); mismatch rolls the energy back every ~10-20 μm. A green laser pointer is 1064 nm frequency-doubled through KTP to 532 nm.) ✅ **frequency-doubling/**
- [x] Van Allen Belts & the Magnetic Mirror (Charged particles perform three nested motions in the geomagnetic field: Larmor gyration about a field line (ms), bouncing between mirror points north and south (~0.1-3 s, first adiabatic invariant μ conserved so v∥→0 in stronger B), and longitude drift around Earth (~5-30 min). The inner belt (~1,000-6,000 km) holds protons, the outer (~13,000-60,000 km) electrons; the offset dipole dips the inner belt to ~200 km over the South Atlantic Anomaly; pitch angles inside the loss cone crash into the atmosphere.) ✅ **van-allen-belts/**
- [x] LEO Constellations & Walker Shells (A 550 km, 53° shell (Starlink gen1: 72 planes × 22, ~4,400 sats) tiles horizon circles into seamless coverage; each pass is visible ~4 minutes and links hand over continuously. RTT 20-40 ms versus 480+ ms for GEO; inter-satellite lasers carry 100-200 Gbps through vacuum (~1.5× faster than glass). Drag self-cleans: a dead satellite reenters in ~5 years. GEO is one satellite for the arc; LEO is a crowd for the ground.) ✅ **leo-constellation/**
- [x] The Scramjet (Past M6, slowing the flow to subsonic combustion costs more than it buys — so the scramjet never slows it: ramp shocks compress, an isolator shock train buffers the inlet from the combustor, and hydrogen jets mix and burn in ~0.5-1 ms inside a 1-2 m duct (flow at 2-3 km/s). Walls take tens of MW/m², regeneratively cooled by the fuel. No compressor, no turbine; it needs a boost past M4.5 to light — X-43A flew M9.6 for 11 seconds in 2004.) ✅ **scramjet/**
- [x] Ant Colony Optimization & Pheromone Feedback (In the real double-bridge experiment ants start 50:50 and minutes later >85-90% take the short bridge — nothing but pheromone feedback plus evaporation. Artificial ants build tours with P_ij∝τ^α·η^β (η=1/distance), deposit 1/L per tour and evaporate at rate ρ (α=1, β=2-5, ants=cities); on 50-100-city TSP they land within 1-2% of optimal but prove nothing — that is what a metaheuristic is.) ✅ **ant-colony-optimization/**
- [x] Video Compression & Motion Compensation (Raw 1080p streams at ~1.5 Gbps; H.264 needs 4-8 Mbps — the savings is temporal redundancy: 16×16 macroblocks find their best match in a reference frame, and only motion vectors plus the small residual (DCT, quantize, entropy-code) are written. I-frames stand alone (~10× a P-frame), P-frames predict forward, B-frames interpolate for another 15-30%, in GOPs of 30-250. Slide the QP and watch blockiness trade against bitrate live.) ✅ **video-compression/**
- [x] The Event Loop & Microtasks (A single-threaded kitchen with one stack of plates: timers go to the Web APIs, the loop takes one macrotask per turn (setTimeout clamps to ≥4 ms), then drains the entire microtask queue (Promise.then) before rendering between batches. Run the classic ordering puzzle live — sync, promise, timeout — then start a microtask storm and watch rendering starve: a 60 fps frame budget is 16.7 ms.) ✅ **event-loop/**
- [x] Helical Scan & the Rotating Head Drum (Tape at 23.39 mm/s is far too slow for MHz bandwidth — so spin the heads: a 62 mm drum at 1,500 rpm carries two heads 180° apart, the tape wraps 221° helically, and each 1/50 s field gets a 58 μm slanted track. Head-to-tape writing speed ~4.9 m/s, ~200× the tape speed. ±6° alternating azimuth beats crosstalk by ~40 dB without guard bands; CTL pulses keep the heads on-track.) ✅ **helical-scan/**
- [x] Direct-Drive vs Planetary Hub Motors (One hub, two answers. Direct drive: an outer-rotor PM motor makes torque at low rpm — gearless, silent, ~85-90% efficient, 4-6 kg, and braking feeds BEMF back to the battery (5-15% range in city riding). Planetary hub: a small fast motor through a 4-9:1 gearset multiplies torque — 1.5-3 kg but 5-10% less efficient, and the freewheel pawls that make coasting silent also cut off regen.) ✅ **direct-drive-wheel/**

Greedy is one O(m) pass: max-degree-first lands on 4-5 colors, a bad order burns 6. A live 48-node planar map flashes conflicts, flips Kempe chains, and tracks χ. Training learns one thing: a network ε_θ(x_t,t) predicts which noise was mixed in, with plain MSE loss.
