Free lift means the forks rise 1-1.5 m before the mast extends, so the truck fits a 2.2-2.5 m container; chains carry a safety factor ≥5; 2500 kg at a 500 mm load center is a 12.3 kN·m tip moment, nearly doubled at 900 mm — load charts, counterweight and 3-6° mast back-tilt hold the front down) ✅ **forklift-mast/**
- [x] Vibratory Roller & Eccentric Excitation (eccentric weights spin in the drum: F=m·e·ω² with m≈45 kg, e≈40 mm, ω≈2π×28 Hz gives ~280 kN — machines reach 200-400 kN, driving a 10-20 t drum to 2-4× its static load; sweeping 25-35 Hz through the 20-30 Hz soil-drum resonance compacts best, with the working point at 1.1-1.3× resonance for stability; cyclic loading repacks grains, void ratio falls 0.62→0.40 and 4-6 passes converge at ~96% compaction; high frequency/low amplitude for thin lifts, low/high for thick; once the force exceeds drum weight the roller skip-jumps — bouncing, not compacting, and beating itself to death; acceptance runs on sand-cone or nuclear density gauges) ✅ **vibratory-roller/**
- [x] Solvay Process & Ammonia Loop (NaCl + CaCO₃ cannot give soda directly — the CaCl₂ has no way out; since 1863 the Solvay brothers have made NH₃ the carrier: brine absorbs ammonia (strongly exothermic), then in a ~24 m carbonating tower meets CO₂ to form NH₄HCO₃ and double-decomposes with NaCl, cooling 60→30 °C so NaHCO₃ - least soluble cold - crashes out past saturation; calcining 2NaHCO₃→Na₂CO₃+CO₂+H₂O sends the CO₂ straight back to the tower; the NH₄Cl mother liquor is steamed with lime milk, ammonia returning at losses <1-2 kg per tonne of soda; sodium conversion is pinned at ~70-75% by NaHCO₃ solubility; CaCl₂ is the only waste — a double ammonia/CO₂ loop, Le Chatelier industrialized; about 2/3 of world soda ash is still made this way) ✅ **solvay-process/**
- [x] VSEPR & Molecular Geometry (valence electron pairs repel toward maximum separation, lone pair-lone pair > lone pair-bond > bond-bond; 2 domains linear 180°, 3 trigonal planar 120°, 4 tetrahedral 109.5°, 5 trigonal bipyramidal (equatorial 120°/axial 90°), 6 octahedral 90°; molecular geometry is what remains after the lone pairs go invisible — and lone pairs are fatter: CH₄ 109.5°→NH₃ 107.3°→H₂O 104.5°; a double bond counts as one domain but a fat one (SO₂ 119°); in trigonal bipyramids lone pairs take the equator (fewer 90° clashes): SF₄ seesaw, ClF₃ T-shape, XeF₂ linear; symmetry cancels bond dipoles — CO₂ and SF₆ are nonpolar while bent H₂O (1.85 D) and pyramidal NH₃ (1.47 D) are not — geometry sets polarity, and polarity sets solubility and boiling point) ✅ **vsepr-shapes/**
- [x] Fischer-Tropsch & Chain Growth (n CO + 2n H₂ → -(CH₂)ₙ- + n H₂O, ~152 kJ/mol released per inserted CH₂ at 200-350 °C and 20-40 bar; cobalt is active and long-lived on hydrogen-rich syngas, iron is cheap and carries water-gas-shift to consume coal-derived H₂/CO≈0.5-0.7; surface polymerization: CO dissociates, carbon hydrogenates to CHₓ, C-C couples and the chain crawls — growth probability α (0.85-0.95) races termination into the Anderson-Schulz-Flory law Wₙ=(1−α)²·n·α^(n−1), ~75% C₅+ at α=0.90; products are near-pure straight chains, diesel cetane >70; from Sasol coal-to-liquid (since 1955) to Qatar's Pearl GTL (140 kb/d) to e-fuels that turn green hydrogen plus captured CO₂ into liquid hydrocarbons) ✅ **fischer-tropsch/**
- [x] Beta-Oxidation & Ketone Bodies (palmitate C16:0 pays 2 ATP for activation, then the carnitine shuttle (CPT-I is the gate, silenced by malonyl-CoA when synthesis is busy) delivers it to the matrix; each round runs oxidize-FAD → hydrate → oxidize-NAD⁺ → thiolase cleave, cutting off one acetyl-CoA and shortening the chain by 2 carbons; 7 rounds yield 8 acetyl-CoA plus 7 FADH₂ (1.5 ATP) and 7 NADH (2.5 ATP): net 8×10+7×4−2 = 106 ATP, roughly triple an equal mass of glucose; fat stores 9 kcal/g dry versus glycogen's 2 g water per g — fat is the dense battery; in fasting, oxaloacetate is drafted into gluconeogenesis, acetyl-CoA piles up, and the liver exports ketone bodies — the brain cannot eat fatty acids across the blood-brain barrier but drinks ketones, 60-70% of its fuel in prolonged fasting; the acetone on a fasting breath is spontaneous decarboxylation) ✅ **beta-oxidation/**
- [x] Urea Cycle & Ammonia Detox (protein breakdown and gut bacteria make ammonia nonstop; above ~100 μM blood NH₄⁺ poisons neurons; across two compartments the hepatocyte packs it into urea: in the mitochondrion CPS-1 spends 2 ATP on NH₄⁺+HCO₃⁻→carbamoyl phosphate (AGA is the obligatory switch), OTC hands it to ornithine making citrulline; out in the cytosol, argininosuccinate synthetase spends another ATP (→AMP, two high-energy bonds) to add aspartate, the lyase drops fumarate, and arginase hydrolysis releases urea while ornithine returns — two nitrogens (one from free ammonia, one from aspartate), 4 ATP, ~0.5 mol (~30 g) a day, half the solutes in urine; the fumarate loops through the TCA cycle and comes back as aspartate — the two cycles interlock as the Krebs bicycle; OTC deficiency is the commonest inborn error, X-linked, and sodium phenylbutyrate offers a bypass by dragging glutamine out in the urine) ✅ **urea-cycle/**
- [x] Bacterial Chemotaxis & Perfect Adaptation (E. coli never steers uphill — it runs and tumbles: counterclockwise flagella bundle into a ~1 s straight run, clockwise unbundling tumbles ~0.1 s into a random heading; up-gradient runs lengthen, down-gradient runs shorten — a biased random walk. It senses change, not concentration: receptor arrays keep a ~1 s memory in methylation, and each tumble is exactly the two-point measurement; attractant binding lowers CheA kinase activity, CheY-P falls, the motor favors CCW and runs extend; CheR methylates at constant rate while CheB-P demethylates only while the kinase is active — integral negative feedback restores activity to baseline 1-10 s after any step (perfect adaptation), sensitivity intact at the new methylation state; 4-5 methylation sites per receptor are the chemical memory — a brainless cell navigating 0.1% gradients at nM sensitivity with an analog integrator) ✅ **chemotaxis/**
- [x] Birefringence & Calcite (in anisotropic crystals the refractive index depends on direction: one beam splits in two — an ordinary ray obeying Snell and an extraordinary ray whose index varies; calcite has n_o=1.658 and n_e=1.486, Δn=0.17, so print under a 1 cm crystal doubles ~6° apart, while along the optic axis both rays agree and the effect vanishes; waveplates perform polarization surgery with path difference δ=2πΔn·d/λ — a quartz λ/4 plate (Δn=0.009) for 589 nm is only ~16 μm thick, turning linear into circular polarization; a λ/2 plate rotates the plane by 2θ; stressed transparent materials go birefringent, and polarized light reveals colored fringes whose order tracks the principal stress difference — photoelasticity in bridge models and tempered-glass QC; an LCD is just a tunable waveplate) ✅ **birefringence/**
- [x] Laser Cooling & Optical Molasses (red-detuned counter-propagating beams intercept atoms via the Doppler shift: an atom walking into the light sees it blue-shifted toward resonance, absorbs hardest, and each photon carries away ħk — ~6 mm/s per event; spontaneous emission sprays randomly, averaging to no push — the net is a viscous drag proportional to velocity; three axis pairs make optical molasses, dragging rubidium-87 from 300 m/s at room temperature to the Doppler limit T_D=ħΓ/2k_B≈146 μK (Γ/2π=6.07 MHz, optimal detuning −Γ/2); polarization-gradient (Sisyphus) cooling drops another decade to ~3 μK; a magneto-optical trap pins the cloud with anti-Helmholtz coils, evaporation trims the hot tail, and near 100 nK the cloud condenses — Chu, Cohen-Tannoudji and Phillips, Nobel 1997) ✅ **laser-cooling/**
- [x] Maxwell's Demon & Landauer's Principle (Maxwell's 1867 demon sorts fast from slow molecules through a trapdoor, raising a temperature gradient for free — a crisis for the Second Law; Szilard (1929) reduced it to a one-molecule engine: the demon must first measure which side the molecule is on, buying 1 bit of information for kT·ln2 of work; Landauer (1961) supplied the answer: measurement can be reversible and free, but erasing one bit (resetting a register) dumps at least k_B·T·ln2 ≈ 2.87×10⁻²¹ J at 300 K and produces k_B·ln2 of entropy — information is physical; Bennett (1982) closed the books: a full memory must be erased before the demon can continue, and the erasure entropy exactly cancels the gradient it built; single-particle experiments in the 2010s reached within 0.003 kT of the limit — the Second Law stands, with information on the invoice) ✅ **maxwell-demon/**
- [x] Planetary Nebulae & Stellar Endings (stars of 0.8-8 M☉ - the Sun included - never reach supernova: AGB thermal pulses shed the envelope in waves, 0.1-0.3 M☉ at 10-30 km/s, baring a ~0.6 M☉ C-O white dwarf at 30,000-150,000 K; hard UV ionizes the ejecta and recombination lights it up: Hα 656 red, [O III] 500.7 green — a famous forbidden line, impossible in any laboratory because the transition probability is minuscule and only 10³-10⁴ /cm³ lets an atom stay undisturbed long enough; Huggins mistook it for the element nebulium in 1864 until Bowen cracked it in 1927; the shell expands to 0.1-0.5 pc, dilutes and fades in ~10,000 years; the Milky Way holds ~3,000 known; binary companions and magnetic fields twist shells into bipolars and cat's eyes; the expelled C, N and O seed the interstellar medium — some of Earth's carbon took this road; the name is Herschel's mistake, thinking of Uranus disks, not planets) ✅ **planetary-nebula/**
- [x] Oort Cloud & Long-Period Comets (the Sun's outermost reach, 2,000-100,000 AU (0.03-1.6 ly), holds trillions (10¹²-10¹³) of icy bodies totaling only ~2-5 Earth masses; they are locals, not visitors — scattered outward by the young giants during the first 100 Myr, with some captured onto distant orbits by the galactic tide; inside ~10⁴ AU the Sun dominates, beyond that binding energies shrink to escape speeds of 0.01-1 cm/s and the galactic tidal torque takes over, a slow hand raising and lowering perihelia; passing stars (one inside 1 pc per ~million years on average) are the second pump, kicking some perihelia back sunward — long-period comets (>200 yr) arrive from near-isotropic inclinations, nothing like the flattened prograde Kuiper belt; Voyager 1 at 17 km/s needed 47 years to reach ~165 AU and would need tens of millennia to exit; 'Oumuamua (2017) proved interstellar space drifts with the same kind of debris) ✅ **oort-cloud/**
- [x] Electric Propulsion & Specific Impulse (in the Tsiolkovsky ledger ΔV=v_e·ln(m₀/m_f) exhaust speed is everything: chemical rockets exhaust at ~4.5 km/s while ion engines accelerate xenon to 30-50 km/s (Isp 3,000-5,000 s) — ten times the ΔV per tonne of propellant, bought with power: thrust F=ṁ·v_e is only 20-700 mN (1 kW ≈ 25-40 mN); a gridded thruster is four parts: a hollow cathode ionizes xenon, screen and accelerator grids at +1,100/−200 V pull the ions out, a neutralizer feeds electrons back so the spacecraft stays neutral, utilization ~90%; Hall thrusters drop the grids for magnetized E×B electrons at higher thrust density (Starlink and the Chinese station fly them); low thrust forgoes Hohmann impulses for a slow spiral — Dawn spread 11 km/s of ΔV over 4 years and ~50,000 hours of firing to visit both Vesta and Ceres, the deepest ΔV mission ever flown) ✅ **electric-propulsion/**
- [x] Upwelling & Fisheries (trades blow along the coast; wind stress plus Coriolis nets a surface transport (Ekman) 90° to the right in the north — surface water skims offshore and 200-1,000 m deep water rises to replace it at just 1-10 m per day; that old water carries NO₃ at 10-30 μM (surface <1 μM), phytoplankton bloom into satellite-visible green belts, and a short food chain follows; the five big systems — Peru-Chile, California, Benguela, Canary, Somali — cover under 2% of the ocean yet land over a fifth of the world's catch, Peru's anchoveta once 12 million tonnes a year; ENSO is the master switch: when El Niño stalls the trades, warm water caps the upwelling, nutrients stop, anchoveta collapse and seabirds starve; upwelling also brings old water's CO₂ and low oxygen — Peru's huge oxygen-minimum zone is the same coin) ✅ **upwelling/**
- [x] Cooling Towers & Evaporative Heat Rejection (a condensing plant is ~40% efficient: every kWh sends ~1.5 kWh of waste heat out at 30-40 °C, and the ~5 kPa condenser vacuum depends on condensing well; the wet tower's ledger: evaporating 1 kg of water absorbs ~2,430 kJ, ~58× the 42 kJ of a 10 K warming, so cooling water 40→30 °C costs only 0.7-1% as vapor; hot water films over PVC fill (~200 m²/m³), air counter-flows and leaves warmer and wetter, and air 1-2% lighter than ambient times 100-200 m of hyperbolic shell drives a megaton-scale draft with no fans — ~1-1.5% of plant output saved; the cooling floor is the ambient wet-bulb: outlet water approaches within 3-6 K, and hot summers force derating; evaporation ~1.5-2% plus 0.5-1% blowdown holds cycles of concentration at 3-6; the white plume is saturated exhaust condensing in cold air — worst in winter; a 1 GW plant evaporates 60-80 thousand m³ a day, the trade-off dry cooling refuses to pay) ✅ **cooling-tower/**
- [x] Fish Swimming & Traveling Waves (a trout carries a backward-running body wave whose amplitude grows from 0.05-0.1 body width at the head to 0.8-1.0 at the peduncle; the wave speed must beat the swim speed (c/U≈1.2-1.5) or the fish stalls in place; thrust comes from a reverse Kármán street: alternating vortices jet water backward and the reaction drives the fish; the Strouhal number St=fA/U sits in a 0.2-0.4 efficient window shared by fish, whales and flapping drones, with cruising efficiency 70-90% against ~60% for early propellers; thunniform swimmers move only the peduncle, and a lunate tail holds efficiency even at 70 km/h sprints; the C-start, ordered by a single Mauthner neuron, bends the whole body into a C in ~0.1 s and fires off at 10-50 g — the body is the propeller) ✅ **fish-swimming/**
- [x] Stable Matching & Gale-Shapley (n men and n women each hold a complete strict ranking of the other side; a matching is stable when no blocking pair exists — no two people who each prefer the other to their assigned partner; a random pairing almost surely contains one. The Gale-Shapley proposal algorithm (1962): unmatched proposers work down their lists, recipients hold their best suitor and defer the rest, the rejected continue — at most n² proposals (64 for n=8), always terminating, always stable; and the asymmetry theorem: proposers win — men-proposing yields the men-optimal, women-pessimal stable matching, which is why real markets hand the proposing role to the weaker side; the NRMP residency match (~40,000 a year), Boston/New York school choice and kidney-exchange chains all descend from it; Roth and Shapley, Nobel Memorial Prize 2012) ✅ **stable-matching/**
- [x] Arithmetic Coding & the Entropy Limit (Huffman's tax: at least one whole bit per symbol — a p=0.9/0.1 source carries 0.469 bit of entropy yet optimal Huffman still spends 1 bit, 113% redundancy; arithmetic coding skips per-symbol codewords and squeezes the whole message into one subinterval of [0,1): split the current interval by the symbol probabilities, nest and narrow symbol by symbol, and finally emit any binary fraction inside — total length ≈ −Σlog₂pᵢ, booked exactly per symbol, redundancy under 0.01%, hugging Shannon's limit; real implementations use fixed-point ranges with carry propagation, and adaptive models update frequencies on the fly so no table is transmitted; CABAC (H.264/HEVC/VVC) and zstd's ANS are its descendants — six symbols from 6 bit down to 5.51 bit, the savings living in the decimals of probability) ✅ **arithmetic-coding/**
- [x] Random Forests & Ensembles (one deep decision tree has huge variance: swap 10% of the training samples and it grows into a different shape — low bias, high variance. Breiman's 2001 random forest double-bags it: (1) bootstrap B resamples (~63.2% unique each, 36.8% out-of-bag) and trains one tree per bag, voting or averaging to divide variance by B; (2) each split sees only mtry≈√p random features, decorrelating the trees; the variance decomposition Var=ρσ²+(1−ρ)σ²/B shows feature randomness squeezing the inter-tree correlation ρ is more fundamental than adding trees — as B→∞ the ρσ² floor remains; OOB samples are a free validation set, error tracking cross-validation; against boosting (serial residual-fitting, cutting bias — XGBoost), forests cut variance: complementary directions) ✅ **random-forest/**
- [x] Stepper Motors & Microstepping (a two-phase hybrid stepper is an electromagnetic gear: a 50-tooth twin-cup rotor around an axial magnet, an 8-pole two-phase stator, and tooth-to-tooth minimum reluctance as the resting point — 360°/(50×4)=1.8° per full step, 200 per revolution; microstepping shapes the currents as i_A=I·cosθ, i_B=I·sinθ so the field vector rotates smoothly — 256 divisions give 0.007° per microstep and near-silent motion; torque T=K·I·sinδ, and past ~2 full steps of load angle the rotor loses sync — open-loop with no encoder, no alarm, the classic 3D-print layer shift; the torque-speed curve dips into a mid-band resonance (~100 Hz) and rolls off at speed as back-EMF strangles the current; 16 microsteps plus a 20-tooth pulley = 80 steps/mm — every printed layer is counted out in steps) ✅ **stepper-motor/**
- [x] Focal-Plane Shutters & Rolling Shutter (the shutter sits just in front of the sensor: two titanium/carbon curtains, the first opens and the second chases it, leaving a slit that sweeps the frame at ~6.4 m/s — exposure time = slit width / curtain speed: 1/8000 s is a 0.8 mm gap diluted by curtain speed; at slow speeds the slit exceeds the frame and the curtains act in turn; flash X-sync (1/200-1/320 s) follows from the same geometry — a flash during a narrow slit lights only one band; strip-by-strip exposure is the price of rolling shutter: a ~3.8 ms scan bends a spinning propeller and tilts a 1.5 m/s sliding rod by 13°; electronic shutters drop the mechanics but read out slower (33-66 ms), ten times the jello, while stacked global shutters sample the whole frame at once at the cost of dynamic range and money; mechanical shutters are rated 150-400 thousand cycles — every click is a two-curtain relay) ✅ **focal-plane-shutter/**
- [x] Ultrasonic Humidifiers & Mist (a PZT disc (Ø16-20 mm) driven at 1.7 MHz resonance (inverse piezoelectric effect, thickness mode) flexes ~1 μm and beams 0.3-1 MPa of ultrasound into the water; radiation pressure lifts a 2-5 cm standing-wave fountain whose cone destabilizes at the capillary scale d∝(σ/ρf²)^{1/3}, shattering into 1-5 μm droplets — pure mechanical cool mist: 200-400 mL/h for 20-30 W, where thermal units burn 300-500 W at 100 °C; higher frequency, finer mist (40 kHz cleaner cavitation bubbles are hundreds of μm); the bill is everything in the water leaves with it: hard-water salts become white dust on furniture and spores ride the aerosol into lungs (humidifier lung) — distilled water and regular disinfection are the discipline; footnotes to pressure atomization and the piezoelectric page) ✅ **ultrasonic-humidifier/**

### Phase 60 · Cross-Family Gap-Fill Batch 31 (24/24 complete)
- [x] Piano Action and Escapement (The key is a two-stage lever: 10 mm of dip amplifies to ~45 mm of hammer travel at ~5x speed. Mid-stroke the set-off lets the jack escape sideways from the roller — the hammer flies the last stretch on inertia, and the back check catches its rebound so it cannot bounce on the string. On release the repetition lever catches the hammer shank while the jack re-arms under its spring: after just 1/3 dip the note can repeat — 13-15 strikes a second, beyond any upright action. Dampers lift with the key and stop the string on release; ppp to fff maps to 0.2-5 m/s hammer speed, a 25-fold dynamic range) ✅ **piano-action/**
- [x] Combination Dial Lock (The dial drives the spindle cam and the first wheel; on reverse turns the parking tabs hand torque wheel by wheel, each wheel stopping at its own notch count. Every wheel carries one gate on its rim — only when all three gates align beneath the fence does it drop, and the levered bolt retracts. 40 marks × 3 wheels = 64,000 combinations dialed right 4, left 3, right 2, left 1, with a ±1.5-notch tolerance set by gate depth. Blind trial expects 32,000 tries — mechanically hopeless; the real attack is the side channel of clicks and feel) ✅ **combination-lock/**
- [x] Vernier Caliper and Micrometer (A main scale of 1 mm lines interpolates by eye to 0.5 mm at best. The vernier spreads 49 mm over 50 divisions, each 0.02 mm short of a main division — find the one aligned pair and the remainder reads directly: 0.02 mm resolution. The micrometer takes the screw road: 0.5 mm pitch across 50 thimble divisions amplifies half a millimetre into 0.01 mm steps, estimable to 0.001; the friction ratchet slips at 5-10 N so every hand measures with the same force. The caliper scale rides 2.6 cm above the measuring line, violating Abbe's principle — a 10-second slide tilt on a 50 mm arm adds 2.4 μm; the micrometer's scale is the screw itself, collinear and Abbe-clean) ✅ **vernier-caliper/**
- [x] Henry's Law and Fizz (Sealed at 3-4 atm of CO2 headspace, Henry's law C=k_H·P (k_H≈0.033 mol/L/atm at 20 °C) dissolves 3-4 volumes of gas. Crack the cap and the pressure falls back to 1 atm: supersaturation of 3-4x — yet homogeneous nucleation is barred by an energy barrier, so bubbles escape only at scratches and seeds, growing 3-10x as they rise (a 2 mm bubble climbs at ~25 cm/s). Shaking multiplies nucleation sites and the bottle foams over; k_H shrinks with heat, which is why warm cola erupts. The hiss in the glass is dozens of fresh nucleation sites starting work at once) ✅ **henry-law/**
- [x] The Lime Cycle and Mortar Curing (Limestone calcines at 825-900 °C: CaCO₃→CaO+CO₂↑ (ΔH=+178 kJ/mol), 44% lighter. Slaking — CaO+H₂O→Ca(OH)₂ — releases 63.9 kJ/mol and swells 1.5-2x, hot enough to boil. On the wall the lime pulls CO₂ back from the air: Ca(OH)₂+CO₂→CaCO₃+H₂O — hardening is literally catching back the calcination's CO₂, creeping inward at ~1 mm a week and releasing a water molecule each step. Mass closes the loop 100→56→74→100: from Roman concrete to modern plaster, one cycle) ✅ **lime-cycle/**
- [x] IR Spectra and Molecular Fingerprints (Bonds are springs at ν̃=(1/2πc)√(k/μ) with reduced mass μ. Hydrogen is cheapest, so every X-H stretch crowds 2850-3600 cm⁻¹ (O-H 3200-3550 and hydrogen-bond broadened, C-H 2850-3000, N-H 3350); triple bonds ring at 2100-2260; the stiff C=O (k≈1200 N/m, μ=6.86 amu) lands at 1650-1800 — ketone 1715, ester 1740, amide 1690, the functional-group scout. Only dipole-changing vibrations absorb IR: CO₂'s symmetric stretch keeps its dipole at zero and stays IR-silent (Raman sees it), while the asymmetric stretch absorbs hard at 2349. Below 1500 cm⁻¹ the fingerprint region is dense and unique — groups give the class, the fingerprint gives the identity) ✅ **ir-spectroscopy/**
- [x] Photoperiod and Phytochrome (Phytochrome Pr (absorbing 660 nm red) converts to Pfr (absorbing 730 nm far-red); Pfr slowly dark-reverts to Pr over hours — the plant's memory of daylight. Short-day plants need one long unbroken night to drop Pfr below threshold before flowering hormone FT rises; a 1-2 minute red flash breaks the night, and a following far-red flash erases the break — a red/far-red reversible switch, togglable again and again (Arabidopsis carries five phytochromes, phyA-E). Long-day plants run the opposite way, Pfr promoting bloom. Plants measure the length of the night, not the day) ✅ **phytochrome-photoperiod/**
- [x] CO2 Transport and the Chloride Shift (Of tissue CO2, 7% dissolves in plasma, 23% carbamylates onto hemoglobin, and 70% becomes bicarbonate inside the red cell, catalyzed by carbonic anhydrase (k_cat≈10⁶ s⁻¹). As HCO₃⁻ leaves down its gradient, positive charge piles up — so Cl⁻ swaps in through the AE1 exchanger: the chloride shift (Hamburger effect), carrying ~70% of the CO2 while keeping the cell neutral. In the lung everything reverses: O₂ binding frees CO₂ (the Haldane effect), bicarbonate swaps back out, and CA rebuilds CO₂ for exhalation. The Bohr effect shifts the O₂ curve right at low pH (P50 26.6→31 mmHg), handing O₂ to the hardest-working tissue) ✅ **co2-transport/**
- [x] Electric Eel and Series Cells (Each electrocyte is a modified muscle cell with ion channels on one face only: ~0.12 V across the membrane. At rest all cells face alike and their external voltages cancel. One nerve command and thousands open in the same direction at once — series stacking gives V=n×0.12 V (5000-6000 cells → 600 V; record 860 V) while parallel bundles supply ~1 A: about 1 kW peak for a 2 ms pulse. Main organ, Hunter's and Sachs' organs wire columns in series and bundles in parallel. Low-voltage ~10 V pulses serve as electroreceptive radar; hunting doublets sync the prey's motor nerves and reveal it; then full trains force spasms. Water shunts most current — the eel wraps the prey into the circuit. Volta's 1800 pile, as his letter to the Royal Society admits, was the electric fish made artificial) ✅ **electric-eel/**
- [x] Quantum Computing and Qubits (A classical bit is 0 or 1; a qubit is α|0⟩+β|1⟩, a point on the Bloch sphere with |α|²+|β|²=1. The H gate spins |0⟩ into a 50/50 superposition, X flips, T adds 45° of phase; CNOT entangles a pair — and n qubits then carry 2ⁿ amplitudes (n=300 exceeds the atom count of the universe). Computing is engineered interference: wrong paths cancel, right paths add, and measurement collapses onto the amplified answer. Grover's search runs π√N/4 iterations for a quadratic speedup, Shor's factoring an exponential one; decoherence and gate error (99-99.9% fidelity today) are the bill — surface-code error correction wants a thousand physical qubits per logical one) ✅ **quantum-computing/**
- [x] Cloud Chamber and Particle Tracks (Dry ice cools the base, alcohol vapor diffuses down from the top, and between them lies a layer supersaturated to ~400%. A charged particle ionizes the gas along its path; the ions seed droplets and a visible track blooms within 10 ms. Alphas (helium nuclei) ionize hard: tracks ~1 mm thick, straight, short (R≈0.31·E^{3/2} cm in air — about 3.5 cm for 5 MeV); betas wind thinly through collision scattering; gammas leave stray sparks; cosmic-ray muons cross the whole chamber at ~1 per cm² per minute. A magnetic field bends tracks by r=p/(qB) to read momentum — Wilson's 1896 device was the first way to see a particle) ✅ **cloud-chamber/**
- [x] Helmholtz Resonance and the Bass-Reflex Box (The air in the cavity compresses — a spring; the slug of air in the neck has mass — an oscillator: f=(c/2π)√(A/(V·L_eff)), with end correction L_eff=L+1.7r. A 500 mL bottle with a 1.8 cm × 8 cm neck hums at ~130 Hz; add water, the cavity shrinks, the spring stiffens, pitch rises. Blowing is a broadband edge tone — only the component nearest resonance gets amplified, so the bottle sings one note. A bass-reflex port is the artificial bottleneck: port mass and box volume tune to Fb (typically 30-45 Hz, below the driver), the rear radiation flips 180° in the resonating column and adds in phase as a second source, stretching bass nearly an octave. At Fb cone excursion is minimum while the port does the work; the price is a 24 dB/oct roll-off below Fb and port noise past ~17 m/s) ✅ **helmholtz-resonance/**
- [x] Magnetars and Starquakes (A massive stellar core collapses to a 10 km neutron star; flux conservation B∝1/R² amplifies the field by 10⁵ and a dynamo adds more — surface fields of 10^14-10^15 gauss (10^10-10^11 T), hundreds of a pulsar's and 10^15 times Earth's. Magnetic pressure B²/2μ₀ at 10^15 G reaches 4×10²⁷ Pa — a dozen orders beyond crust strength. The ~10^40 J of field slowly twists the crust of a 2-12 s spinner until it starquakes: cracks race the surface, field lines snap and re-sort, X-rays flare. The 2004-12-27 giant flare of SGR 1806-20 released ~2×10³⁹ erg in 0.2 s — the Sun's output of 250,000 years — and its gamma front dented Earth's daytime D-layer from 45,000 ly. Dipole braking P∝B²Ω⁴ drains the field in ~10⁴ years; the ~30 known magnetars are just the ones currently lit) ✅ **magnetar/**
- [x] Star Clusters and the Turnoff Point (Open clusters (hundreds to thousands of loose, young, metal-rich stars in the disk) and globulars (a hundred thousand dense, ancient, metal-poor ones in the halo) are the product of one molecular cloud collapsing at once — every member shares age, distance and chemistry. Massive stars burn out first: t_MS≈10 Gyr·(M/M☉)^−2.5, so the cluster's HR diagram peels off the main sequence at the turnoff — the lower the turnoff mass, the older the cluster: Pleiades ~100 Myr (turnoff ~6 M☉), Hyades ~700 Myr, M13 ~12 Gyr (turnoff down to ~0.9 M☉). One HR diagram weighs a cluster's age, and the oldest globulars at 12-13 Gyr set the floor on the age of the universe — 150+ globulars orbit the Milky Way) ✅ **star-clusters/**
- [x] Mars EDL and the Sky Crane (Mars air is 0.6% of Earth's: too thin for aerobraking to finish the job (~93% of the energy is all it can take), too thick to land on rockets alone — so EDL is a four-leg relay. Entry at 5.8 km/s behind a blunt heatshield: ~10 g peak, ~1000 °C-class surface, minutes of communications blackout run purely on the rehearsed timeline. A 21.5 m disk-gap-band chute opens at Mach 1.7 and grinds 400 m/s to ~100; at 2 km the chute goes and eight throttleable engines (20-100% continuous) take over. The last 20 m belong to the sky crane: the stage hovers while 7.5 m bridles pay the 900 kg rover out at 0.75 m/s, wheels touch at under 0.05 m/s; then the stage cuts loose and flies itself 150 m away to crash. Curiosity 2012 and Perseverance 2021 flew the same plan — one shot, no retry) ✅ **mars-edl/**
- [x] Rocket Staging and Separation (Tsiolkovsky: ΔV=v_e·ln(m₀/m_f), and dry mass — structure, engines, tank walls — eats the ratio linearly. At 6% structure and 2% payload a single stage logs only 7.6 km/s, short of the 9.4 needed for orbit. Staging splits the logarithm: burn out a segment, drop the tank and engine whole, and thrust-to-weight climbs instead of falling — three stages at ~75% propellant each stack to ~11.6 km/s with margin for losses, 3-4 km/s per stage with diminishing returns. At separation the propellant floats (ullage) — small retro-thrusters or springs settle it so the upper engine can light; Max-Q calls for throttle. Saturn V's S-IC carried 137 t of dry mass through 2200 t of propellant; Falcon 9 lifts 549 t and drops a ~25 t first stage) ✅ **rocket-staging/**
- [x] Tidal Bores and the Moving Hydraulic Jump (The flood tide pours into a funnel estuary — the Qiantang, the Severn; the cross-section narrows and the crest is pumped higher. Shallow-water speed √(gh) grows with depth, so the crest overtakes the trough and the front steepens until it breaks — a sheer wall advancing upstream at c=√(g·h₂(h₁+h₂)/2h₁): a moving hydraulic jump. The Froude number Fr₁=(c−u₁)/√(g·h₁) sets the form: undular between 1 and 1.5 with a train of secondary waves, breaking beyond 1.5. Conjugate depths follow momentum, not energy (turbulence dissipates it): h₂/h₁=(√(1+8Fr²)−1)/2. At Yanguan the bore stands 5-9 m, runs 5-7 m/s against the river for 1-3 km; the Severn's is ~2 m. The river still flows seaward underneath — tide and river in open conflict, and the scouring, the swimmers and the surfers all ride that momentum) ✅ **tidal-bore/**
- [x] Icebreakers and Ice Bending (Ice crushes at 3-5 MPa but bends at only 0.5-1 — a five-fold gap, so an icebreaker climbs rather than rams. The stem, raked ~20° at the waterline, slides onto the ice edge; tens of thousands of tonnes become a root bending moment σ=6Wl/(bh²), with the ride-up transferring P≈2% of weight as the vertical load. When the arm reaches the breaking length l*=σ_b·b·h²/(6P) the sheet cracks radially and the sector capsizes — and since σ scales with 1/h², 2 m ice has four times the arm of 1 m ice: even a 55 MW nuclear breaker holds only 2-3 knots in 2-3 m ice. Sectors capsize, broken floes wash astern, and beam plus the barrel bow carve a 20-30 m channel. A blunt bow butts the edge head-on — compressive strength lands on its own stem, no ride-up, no moment arm: it crushes itself) ✅ **icebreaker/**
- [x] Minimax and Alpha-Beta Pruning (On the game tree MAX and MIN alternate; leaf evaluations backpropagate to the best move. Naive search costs b^d leaves — chess with b=35 at depth 6 is 1.8 billion. Track α, the floor MAX has already secured, and β, the ceiling MIN has allowed: the moment α≥β at a node, the opponent would never let the play arrive — the whole subtree is cut. Better move ordering prunes harder: at best O(b^(d/2)), twice the depth for the same compute (1.8 billion leaves down to ~40,000). Deep Blue's brute-force layer and AlphaGo's search tree both stand on it) ✅ **minimax-alphabeta/**
- [x] Byzantine Fault Tolerance (A traitor general sends different orders to different people — Lamport, Shostak and Pease, 1982: against f traitors the honest nodes must number n≥3f+1 and exchange f+1 rounds of messages. The oral-messages protocol: everyone relays exactly what they received to everyone else, and each node finally takes a majority — the honest 2f+1 votes drown the traitor's f fakes. Two-thirds is a hard ceiling; beyond 3f+1 no algorithm helps. The two-generals problem proves the information-theoretic obstacle when the channel itself is unreliable. PBFT industrialized the protocol in three phases (pre-prepare, prepare, commit) at n=3f+1, and Bitcoin traded rounds for a probabilistic version — the blockchain's trust machine is its most famous descendant) ✅ **byzantine-fault/**
- [x] Cryptographic Hashes and the Avalanche Effect (Any input in, a fixed 256-bit digest out. Input is cut into 512-bit blocks and chained through a compression function (Merkle-Damgård); SHA-256 runs 64 rounds per block — rotations, Sigma functions, Ch/Maj choices, addition mod 2³², seasoned with 64 constants — each round stirring the previous round's differences beyond guessing. Avalanche: one flipped input bit changes ~128 output bits (50%±0.08%) — the two digests look unrelated. Collisions ride the birthday bound: the probability crosses half near n≈2^(256/2)=2¹²⁸ tries — that is the 128-bit security a 256-bit digest buys. Stored passwords need salt plus a slow function (bcrypt/argon2, thousands of iterations): salt makes every hash unique against rainbow tables, and slowness taxes a GPU's 10^10 guesses a second by five orders of magnitude) ✅ **cryptographic-hash/**
- [x] Rolling Codes and Anti-Replay (A fixed-code fob dies to one capture-and-replay. Rolling codes share a counter and a key between fob and car: every press transmits E_K(counter++), and the car accepts only if the decrypted counter falls inside a sync window (typically the next 256) — a replayed message is expired on arrival: a recorded code works exactly once. Press the fob hundreds of times out of range and it desyncs; the car resyncs through the window, and only beyond it falls back to pairing. Keeloq packs 66 bits (32 serial + 28 counter + 4 buttons + 2 check); modern systems use AES-128 variants. Relay attacks never break the code — they just forward the signal in real time so the car believes the key is at the door; the defense is distance) ✅ **rolling-code/**
- [x] Optical Image Stabilization and Gyro Feedback (Handshake is angular wander of ±0.5-1° at 5-8 Hz; in a 1/30 s exposure the lens swings ~0.2° and the image smears across dozens of pixels. A gyroscope senses the rate, the controller computes the correction, and a voice-coil motor (~10 ms response) shifts the floating lens group perpendicular to the axis by δ=f·tanθ (0.87 mm per degree at 50 mm, 1.05 mm at 60) — bouncing the light back to the same pixel. That buys 3-5 stops of shutter (8-32x exposure); in-body stabilization moves the sensor instead, and five-axis adds pitch and roll. The limit: OIS stills the camera, not the subject — panning shots still blur, and 10 ms cannot outrun a jolt) ✅ **optical-stabilization/**
- [x] The Bicycle Wheel and Pretension (A 2 mm spoke, 260 mm long, buckles at Pcr=π²EI/L²≈23 N — it could not hold a kettle. The wheel lives on pretension: 32 spokes each pulled to ~1000 N (90-130 kgf) draw the rim into a prestressed structure whose stiffness and side-load strength are all tension field. A 500 N rider only unloads the spokes below the hub by 10-15% (ΔT≈0.12·W) while the top barely changes — the hub hangs from the upper spokes rather than standing on the lower. The field is redundant: cut one spoke and its four neighbors share the load, leaving a small dimple. Uneven tension, and the rim hops in a figure of eight — truing is tuning the whole field spoke by spoke) ✅ **spoke-wheel/**

### Phase 59 · Cross-Family Gap-Fill Batch 30 (24/24 complete)
- [x] Scroll Compressor &amp; the Orbiting Wrap (Two Archimedean wraps mesh 180° out of phase; the orbiting wrap is dragged by the crank pin around a circle of e=4 mm — pure revolution, never rotation — while an Oldham ring with two mutually perpendicular slots blocks its spin. Gas enters at the outer ports; each revolution advances every crescent chamber one full pitch (≈25 mm) toward the center, shrinking volume and raising pressure along P=P_s·(V_s/V)^1.15 until the center chamber pops the discharge valve. Suction, compression and discharge coexist at every instant, so flow is nearly pulseless. Displacement V_s=2πe·p·h·(2N−1)≈90.5 cm³/rev; the built-in volume ratio fixes the inner pressure ratio (0.5 → 2.0 MPa = 4), and off-design operation over- or under-compresses. Inverter speed control of 20–120 r/s gives stepless capacity with no reciprocating mass — the mainstream of air conditioners and heat pumps) ✅ **scroll-compressor/**
- [x] Turning &amp; Chip Formation (The tool feeds f=0.2 mm per revolution at depth ap=1.5 mm, and the material shears instantly across a narrow band at the shear angle φ≈25° — cutting is controlled shear instability, not scraping. Merchant's relation φ=45°−β/2+γ/2 ties rake γ and friction angle β into the shear angle. On steel with kc≈2400 N/mm²: F_c=kc·ap·f=720 N and P=F_c·v_c≈2.4 kW at MRR=200×1.5×0.2=60 cm³/min. Eighty percent of the heat rides away on the chip; the rake face is hottest at 700–900 °C and climbs with speed. Swing the rake from +10° to −10° and ribbon chips turn segmented while force and temperature rise. At 30–60 m/min a built-up edge grows and tears off, marring the finish. Flank wear VB to 0.3 mm calls the tool change; Taylor's v·Tⁿ=C (n≈0.3) means doubling speed costs 7/8 of tool life) ✅ **metal-cutting/**
- [x] Pneumatic Cylinder &amp; the 5/2 Valve (0.6 MPa air flows through a 5/2 valve into the cap side of a Ø32 bore: A=πD²/4=804 mm² and F=p·A≈483 N. Speed is set by meter-out throttling — exhaust restriction lets back-pressure steady the load, while meter-in crawls. At stroke end a cushion spear seals the exhaust port and trapped gas compresses to absorb the impact, E≈p·V·ln(p/p₀). Slide the spool 5 mm and the whole circuit mirrors, retracting the rod; a small pilot solenoid commands the big flow. Compressibility is the bill: a sudden load sags the piston and low speeds crawl. Against hydraulics the force density is lower, but it is fast, clean and cheap — factories run this closed loop ten thousand times a minute) ✅ **pneumatic-cylinder/**
- [x] Optical Rotation &amp; Enantiomeric Excess (Plane-polarized light is the equal-amplitude sum of left and right circular polarization; a chiral medium refracts the two differently (n_L≠n_R), and the accumulated phase shift recombines into a rotated plane: α=[α]·l·c, with sucrose at [α]_D^20=+66.5°·mL/(g·dm) on the sodium D line (589 nm, 1 dm tube, 1 g/mL). Enantiomeric excess reads straight off the rotation, ee%=α_obs/α_pure×100, and a racemate cancels to zero. Glucose mutarotates from the α form's +112° toward +52.7° (t½≈30 min). Crossing the analyzer until the field goes dark is the "zero" of every measurement — the sugar industry's saccharimeter and pharma's ee QC (with thalidomide as the footnote) ✅ **optical-rotation/**
- [x] Close Packing &amp; Unit Cells (Equal spheres pack one layer A at closest spacing (six neighbors each), layer B drops into every hollow, and the third layer forks: back on A gives hexagonal HCP (ABAB… Mg, Zn, Ti), onto fresh positions C gives cubic FCC (ABCABC… Cu, Al, Au, Ag) — both with coordination 12 and packing fraction π/(3√2)=74.05%. Body-centered BCC manages only 68% with 8 neighbors (α-Fe); copper's lattice constant a=2√2·r=0.361 nm. What really sets properties are the interstices: octahedral holes (r=0.414r) let γ-Fe (FCC) dissolve 2.11 wt% carbon while α-Fe (BCC) takes only 0.022 wt% — a hundredfold gap that underwrites quenched martensite's supersaturation. FCC's dense {111} slip planes make gold hammerable to 0.1 μm foil) ✅ **crystal-packing/**
- [x] Brownian Motion &amp; the Perrin Experiment (Brown watched pollen grains jitter in 1827; Einstein in 1905 gave ⟨x²⟩=2Dt and D=kT/(6πηr) (Stokes–Einstein); Perrin in 1908 loaded gutti emulsion into micron grid squares: a 0.5 μm grain in 20 °C water has D≈4.4×10⁻¹³ m²/s and a 1 s rms step of ≈0.94 μm. Under gravity-diffusion balance the grains stratify exponentially, n(h)=n₀·exp(−mgh/kT); counting squares yields k_B and NA=6.7×10²³ (today 6.022×10²³, within 11%) — atomism turned from hypothesis into measurement. Warm water 20→80 °C and viscosity falls 1.002→0.355 mPa·s, tripling D. In 2019 the SI redefinition made NA=6.02214076×10²³ exact by definition) ✅ **brownian-motion/**
- [x] Prions &amp; Misfolded Propagation (PrP^C is alpha-helical, soluble and GPI-anchored on neuronal membranes; misfold to PrP^Sc and beta-sheet climbs from ~3% to ~43%, stacking into amyloid fibrils. With no nucleic acid at all it "replicates" by template induction: the fibril end captures normal PrP^C, flips it into its own fold and adds it to the chain; a mid-fibril break turns one seed into two and counts climb exponentially. Deposits plaque, neurons vacuolize — the spongiform brain of BSE, scrapie, CJD and kuru. The species barrier is sequence mismatch: cattle→cattle binding ≈100% but cattle→human ≈3%, so vCJD is rare yet not zero. Inactivation is brutal: 134 °C steam for 18 min or 1 mol/L NaOH for 1 h; routine disinfection fails. Prusiner's 1997 Nobel — the edge case of the central dogma) ✅ **prion/**
- [x] Fertilization &amp; the Acrosome Reaction (Of 200–500 million ejaculated sperm, only hundreds reach the egg after the cervix and 15–18 cm of oviduct. Capacitation sheds cholesterol and whips the tail harder; zona protein ZP3 triggers the acrosome reaction — the vesicle everts and acrosin dissolves a ~15 μm tunnel. Through the zona, IZUMO1–JUNO lock sperm and egg membranes, and a calcium wave sweeps the ~100 μm egg from the fusion point at 5–30 μm/s (10–30 s), activating it. Cortical granules exocytose and harden the zona (the zona reaction) against latecomers — polyspermy means three genomes and developmental collapse. Pronuclei merge within 24 h, meiosis II completes, and the first cleavage divides. Block the cortical reaction experimentally and a second sperm drills in — the embryo falls apart on the spot, the reason the hardened zone exists) ✅ **fertilization/**
- [x] Phloem &amp; Pressure Flow (Companion cells in source leaves burn ATP to load sucrose into sieve tubes; sap at 0.5–1.2 mol/L sucrose carries 1–3 MPa of osmotic pressure, water floods in, turgor rises. At sinks — roots, fruit — sugar unloads and pressure falls. The 0.5–2 MPa difference drives the sap 0.3–1.5 m/h with no pump anywhere: Münch's pressure-flow hypothesis. Mature sieve elements discard their own nuclei and open their ≈1 μm sieve pores, kept alive by companion cells. Girdle the bark and sugar swells above the cut while below starves. An aphid stylet pierced into a sieve tube is a natural pressure gauge — honeydew drips and turgor reads 0.5–2 MPa, the collective-flow ledger mirrored against xylem's transpiration pull) ✅ **phloem/**
- [x] Field Lines &amp; Gauss's Law (Field-line density is field strength; ∮E·dA=Q_enc/ε₀ — a point charge sends the same total flux through any closed surface: stretch the Gaussian sphere to double radius and surface density quarters while the count never changes, because flux counts only the charge inside. A uniformly charged shell is exactly zero inside (the shell theorem, gravitation too) and point-like outside; park a wandering charge outside and the interior reading never stirs — the prototype of electrostatic shielding. Change symmetry, change the surface: an infinite line charge gives E=λ/(2πε₀r) (1 μC/m at 1 cm: 1.8×10⁶ V/m), an infinite plane E=σ/(2ε₀) independent of distance (1 μC/m² → 5.65×10⁴ V/m). On a conductor at rest, charge crowds entirely to the surface and the interior field is zero — the Faraday cage falls out as a corollary) ✅ **gauss-field/**
- [x] Double Pendulum &amp; Sensitive Dependence (A single pendulum is a tidy quasi-periodic world; hang on a second arm and raise the energy past a threshold and the motion turns wild — chaos, not randomness: the equations are exact (RK4 fixed-step, energy drift &lt;0.1%) and the initial state fully known, yet the future still escapes. Initial error grows as δ(t)=δ₀·e^{λt}; with l₁=l₂=1 m the largest Lyapunov exponent is λ≈1.5 s⁻¹, doubling every 0.46 s, so a 10⁻⁶ rad head start swells to 1 rad in ~9 s — the mechanical butterfly effect. At low energy the motion stays near-periodic: chaos has an energy gate. A Poincaré section slices the continuous trace into points — closed rings for regular, shredded cloud for chaotic, kin to the Lorenz attractor and the three-body problem) ✅ **double-pendulum/**
- [x] The Casimir Effect &amp; Vacuum Fluctuations (In quantum field theory the vacuum seethes with zero-point jitter — ½ħω per mode, forever. Insert two parallel plates a distance d apart: only standing waves λ=2d/n fit between them while the outside continuum is dense — the modes "deleted" from the gap leave it with lower energy density, and the pressure imbalance pushes the plates together: F/A=π²ħc/(240d⁴), giving 1.3 mPa at 1 μm, 13 Pa at 100 nm, 0.13 MPa ≈ 1.3 atm at 10 nm — shrink the gap 100× and the force grows 10⁸×, brutal d⁻⁴ scaling. Lamoreaux's 1997 torsion pendulum measured it over 0.6–6 μm to 5% agreement; MEMS parts within 100 nm stick permanently (stiction) — the vacuum has become a constraint nanodevice designers must compute) ✅ **casimir/**
- [x] Helioseismology &amp; the Sun's Interior (The sun's surface ripples with ~5-minute p-modes (ν≈3 mHz) — over a million identified oscillations. Each mode's depth reach is set by its spatial scale: small modes skitter along shallow layers, large ones dive through the core, and the spectral comb of a million modes is the sun's CT scan. Inverting it yields a sound-speed profile that brushes the standard solar model with a small kink at 0.713 R☉ (the convection-zone base). Frequency splitting reads the internal rotation: 25 days at the equator, 34 at the poles, yet near-rigid ~27 days within 0.7 R☉ — the tachocline shear layer is the dynamo's cradle and the source of the sunspot cycle. Far-side holography even uses modes emerging from the back to "hear" sunspots before they rotate into view) ✅ **helioseismology/**
- [x] Core-Collapse Supernova &amp; the Neutrino Burst (A massive star's iron core grows to the Chandrasekhar limit 1.4 M☉ and electron degeneracy fails: in 0.2 s it collapses from thousands of km to 30 km at ~0.23c infall. Neutronization — protons capturing electrons — floods the star with neutrinos first. The rebound shock races out, is eaten by iron dissociation and stalls; neutrino heating revives it — the supernova is blown up by neutrinos. Of 3×10⁴⁶ J released, 99% leaves in a 10-second neutrino burst and only 0.01% as light. SN 1987A: Kamiokande 11 + IMB 8 + Baksan 5 = 25 neutrinos arrived 13 seconds ahead, with visible light 3 h 25 min behind (51.4 kpc, LMC). The ⁵⁶Ni (6.1 d) → ⁵⁶Co (77 d) → ⁵⁶Fe decay chain powers the radioactive tail of the light curve) ✅ **core-collapse-supernova/**
- [x] The Cosmic Distance Ladder (Measuring the sky takes a four-rung relay: ① parallax — Earth's orbit as baseline, d=1/p″, with Gaia at 0.02 mas reliable to tens of thousands of light-years; ② cluster main-sequence fitting bridges to clusters parallax can't reach; ③ the Cepheid period–luminosity law — period is brightness (M≈−2.81·log₁₀(P/10d)−4.18) — let Hubble find one in Andromeda in 1923 and settle the "island universe" debate; ④ Type Ia supernovae at M_B≈−19.3 carry uniform candlepower to ten billion light-years and feed the Hubble flow v=H₀d. Each rung is calibrated by the one below, errors compounding to ~14% cumulatively. Today's crack: the near ladder gives H₀=73.0±1.0 while the CMB + ΛCDM give 67.4±0.5 — the ~5σ "Hubble tension", modern cosmology's most famous open case) ✅ **distance-ladder/**
- [x] Salt Fingering &amp; Double Diffusion (Seawater density is set by temperature and salinity together, but heat diffuses ~100× faster than salt: κT≈1.4×10⁻⁷ m²/s against κS≈10⁻⁹. Press warm salty water over cold fresh and the ~1 mm interface gains heat fast while gaining salt slowly; pockets turn heavy and sink, growing "salt fingers" 2–5 cm wide and 20–50 cm long that dangle down like fishing lines, steadily exporting heat and salt into the abyss — a single finger wobbles, but a forest hangs together. Mediterranean outflow water (38 PSU) spills past Gibraltar into a kilometer-scale salt-finger field in the Atlantic — a cog in global mixing and the climate conveyor. Reverse the stack — cold salty over warm fresh — and stair-stepped thermohaline layers grow instead; oceanographers built both regimes in the lab in 1960) ✅ **salt-fingering/**
- [x] Brine Rejection &amp; the Brinicle (Sea ice starts freezing at −1.9 °C: pure ice crystals form first and salt is expelled into the trapped brine (brine rejection), pushing ice-gap salinity to 3–5× seawater (150 PSU) and the freezing point down to −8.1 °C via Tf≈−0.054·S. On a −30 °C polar winter night the brine chills to −20 °C. This cold, extra-salty brine (ρ≈1120 kg/m³) pours down cracks; the −1.9 °C seawater around the channel freezes onto it, building a downward-growing ice tube (brinicle) that typically reaches tens of meters in hours. Touching bottom, brine spreads and the freeze-ring expands — sea urchins and starfish freeze where they stand (BBC's famous 2011 time-lapse). Under Antarctic ice shelves the same mechanism scales up into under-ice flower beds and brine channels) ✅ **brinicle/**
- [x] Oscillating Water Column Wave Energy (Deep-water waves carry P/B=ρg²H²T/(64π) per meter of crest: ≈18 kW/m at H=2 m, T=9 s, and 20–70 kW/m offshore Atlantic. An oscillating water column (OWC) turns the chamber into a loudspeaker box: the front wall's opening sits below the waterline, waves pump the water column like a piston, and the reciprocating air spins a Wells turbine — symmetric blades rotate the same way whichever way the air flows, so the wave's reciprocation becomes "DC" at the shaft. Tuning the chamber's 8–12 s natural period to the swell gains real power; off-tune leaves scraps. Scotland's Islay LIMPET fed 500 kW to the grid (2000). The bill: Wells blades stall at high incidence and end-to-end efficiency runs 30–50%. Family: overtopping devices (store, then drain through turbines) and the duck (phase-oscillating)) ✅ **wave-energy/**
- [x] Quantum Key Distribution BB84 (Alice encodes random bits into photon polarization using two random bases (+ at 0°/90°, × at 45°/135°); Bob measures in his own independent random basis — right basis, 100% right bit; wrong basis, a 50/50 coin flip. They publish bases (never bits), keeping the sifted key. An eavesdropper must measure: she picks the wrong basis half the time and "resets" the state to her result, injecting ≈25% QBER — compare a public sample and any QBER past the 11% threshold kills the whole key on the spot. The no-cloning theorem forbids "copy and put it back", so security rests on physical law, not computational hardness. In practice fiber links reach ~100 km before attenuation wins; the Micius satellite distributed keys over 1200 km in 2017) ✅ **bb84/**
- [x] Nash Equilibrium &amp; the Prisoner's Dilemma (Two prisoners in separate rooms: both silent, 1 year each; both confess, 8 each; one confesses, 0 and 10. Whatever the other does, confessing pays more — the dominant strategy — so (confess, confess) is the only Nash equilibrium (no one gains by moving alone), yet it is worse for both than (silent, silent). Not a morality problem: the geometry of equilibrium. Repeated play grows cooperation — tit-for-tat won Axelrod's 1980 computer tournament twice. Matching pennies at 50/50 randomization is the mixed-strategy equilibrium with exactly level expected payoffs. In replicator dynamics a purely nice population is grazed down by defectors until tit-for-tat enters and red and blue settle into coexistence. Price wars, arms races and the tragedy of the commons are the same payoff matrix) ✅ **nash-equilibrium/**
- [x] Hypothesis Testing &amp; the p-value (H₀: the coin is fair (p=0.5). Nine heads in ten flips: p=P(this extreme or worse|H₀)=2×[C(10,9)+C(10,10)]/2¹⁰=2.15% &lt; α=0.05 → reject H₀. But the p-value is not "the probability H₀ is true" — it assumes H₀ and measures how odd the data are. The α line trades two errors: type I jails a fair coin (rate α), type II frees a bent one (rate β); slide α from 0.05 to 0.01 and the shaded tails narrow while verdicts flip. Sample size buys power: at p=0.7, n=10 gives 15% power, n=200 passes 99%. Multiple comparisons: test 20 independent coins and at least one reads "significant" with probability 1−0.95²⁰≈64% — somebody always takes the fall. The Bayesian mirror: P(unfair|9/10)≈90% is the posterior — belief, finally, in numbers) ✅ **hypothesis-testing/**
- [x] Breathalyzers &amp; Fuel-Cell Sensing (Alcohol partitions between blood and alveolar air at ≈2100:1 by volume (Henry's law, 35 °C) — 0.38 mg/L of breath maps to 80 mg/100 mL of blood, no needle required. A 5-second blow matters because only the deep-alveolar tail is in equilibrium with blood; the front is mouth residue. In the fuel cell, ethanol oxidizes at the platinum working electrode, CH₃CH₂OH+H₂O→CH₃COOH+4H⁺+4e⁻, the counter electrode reduces O₂, and the external current is proportional to concentration; integrating the current yields BAC. The body clears ≈0.015 g/dL per hour — one beer takes about 2 hours. China's lines: 20 mg/100 mL (driving after drinking) and 80 (drunk driving). Consumer semiconductor-oxide units false-alarm on perfume, acetone and even breath spray; enforcement units calibrate monthly on standard gas to ±5%) ✅ **breathalyzer/**
- [x] Haptics: ERM vs LRA (An eccentric-rotating-mass motor flings inertia: F=m·e·ω² at 12000–17000 rpm maps to 200–280 Hz vibration, but rotor inertia needs 30–50 ms to spin up and leaves a 100+ ms tail — the blurry "bzzz". A linear resonant actuator hangs a ~0.5 g magnetic mass on a spring resonant at ~175 Hz (iPhone-Taptic class); with Q≈10–30 it answers instantly, and reverse-current braking stops it in 10–20 ms for a crisp "tap". The ERM pays for spin-up and spin-down; the LRA is efficient only at resonance, sips power, and sits flat against the frame. The haptic language — tap, scroll, error — is written entirely in drive envelopes: the same 50 ms pulse leaves the ERM still warming up while the LRA has already tapped and come home) ✅ **haptic-motor/**
- [x] Railway Turnouts &amp; Frogs (Two switch rails slide 152–160 mm; whichever stock rail they hug decides the route. The point machine throws and locks them electrically, with a closure check: a 4 mm gap between switch and stock rail and the signal stays red — no luck allowed on the railway. The diverging route swings through a large-radius curve; the higher the frog number the gentler the curve: No.12 allows 45 km/h lateral, No.18 80, high-speed No.42 up to 160. Where the routes cross, the rails must be broken open to leave a flangeway — the frog's "dangerous space" — and a check rail with a 42 mm groove steers each wheelset across the gap. ### Phase 58 · Cross-Family Gap-Fill Batch 29 (24/24 complete)
- [x] Bevel Gears &amp; Intersecting Shafts (Two shafts cross at 90° with axes meeting at the cone apex; the drive is two pitch cones rolling tangent along a common generatrix, and the ratio is pure tooth count, i=z₂/z₁=40/12≈3.33: 1200→360 rpm with torque 20→66.7 N·m. Straight bevel teeth run parallel to the generatrix, so each tooth slams in along its whole line at once (~85 dB); spiral bevels at β≈35° walk the contact progressively across 2–3 teeth, dropping noise to ~74 dB — the car-axle choice. The bill is axial thrust: tangential force F_t=2T₁/d₁≈833 N leaves only ~87 N of pressure-angle component on a straight bevel, but a spiral demands F_a=F_t·tanβ≈583 N — nearly 7× — so tapered roller bearings must hold the shaft. Twist the shaft angle from 90° to 60° and the cone angles recompute while the cones still roll tangent: pure-rolling geometry is unchanged) ✅ **bevel-gears/**
- [x] Dual-Clutch &amp; Pre-Engagement Shifting (A dual-clutch gearbox is two half-gearboxes in one: the hollow outer shaft carries gears 1/3/5 through clutch K1, the solid inner shaft runs inside it carrying 2/4/6 through K2, both fed by one flywheel. With 250 N·m of engine torque and a 1st-gear ratio of 3.8, K1 delivers 950 N·m to the wheels while K2, fully open, lets the synchronizer drag the inner shaft to 830 rpm and pre-engage 2nd. The upshift is one venting and one filling: K1 depressurizes as K2 pressurizes over a 150–250 ms overlap, burning 670 rpm of slip as clutch-plate heat while wheel torque steps 950→525 N·m without ever reaching zero. Overlap under ~120 ms digs a torque hole; over ~300 ms the early K2 flares the engine. A manual does the same job in ~700 ms with torque at zero, and if pre-engagement fails the fail-safe re-closes K1 to rescue the torque) ✅ **dual-clutch/**

Drive the outer race forward and friction walks each roller up the pocket ramp into the narrowing wedge: the wedging angle α=5° sits below the friction angle φ=arctan 0.15=8.5°, and a tanα/tanφ=1.71× margin lets the rollers jam between the races within 0.1 s — the wedge normal force amplifies friction so a small tangential grip carries big torque. In reverse the rollers roll back into their pockets, clearance returns to 0.16R, and the output freewheels at up to 3000 rpm — the bike-freewheel click, the starter pinion, the torque-converter stator one-way clutch. Slide the wedge angle past 8.5° and the self-lock condition tanα&lt;tanφ breaks: rollers climb and get pushed back, never seating, input spinning free — which is why real designs keep 4–6° with only a 1.4–2.1× margin) ✅ **sprag-clutch/**
- [x] Molecular Polarity &amp; Dipole Moments (Bond dipoles come from electronegativity gaps: chi(H)=2.20, C=2.55, N=3.04, Cl=3.16, O=3.44 give 1.08 D (H-Cl), 0.40 D (C-H), 1.30 D (N-H), 1.50 D (O-H) and 2.30 D (C=O), each arrow pointing at the delta-minus end. The net dipole mu is their vector sum over the VSEPR geometry: linear CO2 (180°) cancels, tetrahedral CH4 (109.47°) cancels exactly, bent H2O (104.5°) sums to 2x1.50xcos(52.25°)=1.85 D, and pyramidal NH3 (107°) gives 1.47 D. Drag the angle slider: bending CO2 by 30° conjures about 1.19 D, flattening NH3 toward 120° kills the dipole, and nudging CH4 off 109.47° breaks the cancellation. A 2.45 GHz rotating field then torques every mu&gt;0 molecule via tau=mu x E — it chases the field and heats by friction, the microwave-oven principle — while mu=0 molecules barely respond) ✅ **molecular-polarity/**

Effusion through a porous wall runs at the wall-hit frequency, giving Graham&amp;apos;s law r1/r2=√(M2/M1) — 4.00:1 for H2 versus O2, which 150 live particles racing the wall demonstrate as the counters converge on 4:1. The temperature slider verifies the √T law: 300→1200 K barely doubles speeds. Withholding the juice then yields δ=−V, a 0.2–2 s dip below baseline — the physical shape of disappointment. All four Königsberg vertices are odd — Euler proved it impossible in 1736. ### Phase 45 deep dives (condensed)

- **journal-bearing/** — The shaft visibly peels off the bore bottom as the converging wedge ignites a pressure ring, h_min reading out in real microns while friction falls a hundredfold; push rpm on a light load and the journal center starts its ominous half-frequency whirl orbit.
- **pantograph/** — A five-pointed star is traced live while the pencil draws its ρ-scaled twin right beside it, both trails growing in sync; drag the ratio from 0.5× to 3× and the same four bars re-prove the collinearity OF/OD=ρ at every pose.
- **wood-joinery/** — The dovetail seats itself in slow motion, then an auto-ramping pull lights up the flank normals while the joint refuses to budge — switch to the straight tenon and the same force walks it out of the socket, and a moisture slider shows the gap wood movement demands.
- **condensation-polymerization/** — A nylon filament rises continuously off the two-liquid interface onto a spinning spool while the Flory histogram marches toward high n and the water counter ticks with every new bond; nudge the monomer ratio off 1:1 and X̄n slams into its cap in real time.
- **electrophilic-aromatic-substitution/** — NO₂⁺ dives into the glowing π cloud, the ring puckers into a σ-complex with its aromatic halo snuffed out, then HSO₄⁻ plucks H⁺ and the golden ring flares back on — while the energy diagram's dot hops two small hills right beside the dashed aromaticity mountain.
- **metal-displacement/** — The nail sits in blue CuSO₄ while copper fuzz blossoms along its flank and the blue drains to pale green with ΔG=−nFΔE counting down; flip to copper-in-FeSO₄ and nothing moves, then grind aluminum's oxide film and the displacement erupts.
- **complement-cascade/** — Cascade nodes ignite one by one down an arc while a C3b counter explodes exponentially and opsonin dots carpet a bacterium; the signature moment is the MAC assembling in slow motion, C9 monomers dropping into the membrane ring by ring before water floods in and the cell bursts.
- **endosymbiosis/** — Watch the merger in slow motion: an archaeon wraps a swimming bacterium into a double-membrane vacuole, ATP sparks flow outward, the symbiont divides, and glowing genes hop one by one into the nucleus as the organelle shrinks — scrub the 2-billion-year timeline or flip the mitochondrion/chloroplast branch.
- **ubiquitin-proteasome/** — A misfolded protein is seized by an E3, stamped with a glowing K48 chain, then grabbed by the 19S cap, stripped, straightened into a line and fed through the 20S barrel while peptide bits trickle out of the far end; block the barrel with bortezomib and a queue of tagged corpses piles up at the mouth.
- **capacitor-dielectric/** — Slide the dielectric slab between the plates and watch the field lines shrink, the dipoles snap into alignment and C jump to κC₀ — battery off, the voltmeter sags to V₀/κ in real time; battery on, the charge counter leaps κ-fold; push the field past 3 kV/mm and the gap sparks.
- **groundwater/** — Raindrops stab the recharge hill, percolate to the water table and crawl along the Darcy gradient toward the stream; crank the pump and the cone of depression dents the blue surface on the spot — keep overdrafting through the "years" and the land surface itself sags over the well.
- **matter-waves/** — One electron at a time crosses the slits and ticks onto the screen; from random speckle, cos² fringes condense over ~1500 detections while the histogram's live visibility reads 90%+ — flip the which-path detector and each dot turns red or blue as the fringes dissolve into a smooth envelope.
- **cosmic-inflation/** — A crumpled pocket universe studded with red monopoles is inflated into a glass-smooth ball in seconds: wrinkles flatten, twin light-cone rings get outrun by their own expansion, and the Ω readout collapses to 10⁻⁵² before reheating flashes and a speckled CMB sphere takes the stage. Set fewer than 55 e-folds and the same sphere visibly bends, crumples and recollapses on the spot.
- **planetary-rings/** — A top-down ring disk where 3,800 ice grains obey real Saturnian Kepler periods; a dyed radial line winds into a spiral before your eyes. On load the moon's mass ramps up and the gap carves itself open — drag mass or orbit radius and watch the Cassini-style gap and 2:1 resonance marker respond instantly.
- **venus-greenhouse/** — One planet, one slider: drag the orbit inward toward 0.7 AU and the blue ocean first swells with steam, then vanishes as the vapor shell flares white, the surface glows ember-red at 465 °C, and a stream of photolysed hydrogen motes bleeds off into space — the D/H readout climbing a hundredfold marks the crime scene.
- **kite-aerodynamics/** — Three arrows chained nose-to-tail pin a diamond kite against the wind: drag the wind, line-length or bridle sliders and the triangle re-closes at a new equilibrium angle, drooping to the ground when lift loses to weight and snapping taut when a gust yanks the line. Switch to 4-line mode and the kite carves smoking figure-eights, or to power-kite mode where crosswind circles multiply apparent wind five-fold and rope tension reads out as kilowatts.
- **leidenfrost-effect/** — Three hotplates, three fates for one and the same droplet: at 160 °C it spits and dies in seconds, at 220 °C it thrashes itself apart, yet at 280 °C it rises onto a glowing vapor cushion and wanders calmly while its neighbors perish. Drag the offset slider to shove the middle plate across the ~250 °C Leidenfrost point and watch its regime — and personality — flip live; LN₂ mode and a slow-motion cushion cross-section complete the story.
- **water-turbine/** — A machine hall with Pelton, Francis and Kaplan cut open end to end: sweep the head-flow sliders (or let the auto tour run) and the specific-speed needle lands in a different band — the winning turbine lights up and swallows the whole river while the other two dim to 22% flow with plunging η readouts, and a cavitation toggle seeds imploding bubbles on the runner.
- **numerical-integration/** — Three integrators push the same mass while its energy bar creeps up only under Euler and the phase spiral visibly fattens; flip to the orbit preset and the planet's orange trail peels off the dashed Kepler ellipse into an outward spiral, then push h past the stability edge and the whole thing detonates in one frame.
- **pca-eigenvectors/** — A random orange arrow gets multiplied by C over and over, visibly swinging itself onto the long axis of the 1σ ellipse until the convergence notice reads "matches the analytic axis"; hit project-and-rebuild and 140 dots collapse onto one line, their red residual threads showing exactly the variance PC1 was allowed to forget.
- **union-find/** — A glowing pulse climbs the tallest tree hop by hop, then the entire visited chain audibly "snaps" flat onto the root as arcs re-grow in one flash; toggle both heuristics off and forty random unions later the forest sags into long degenerate chains, while the percolation slider sweeps the 8×8 lattice across the 0.593 spanning threshold.
- **fingerprint-sensor/** — The fingertip descends and 784 cells flip in one by one into a ridge-bright grayscale patch while orange minutiae rings pop onto endings and bifurcations; switch to capacitive + wet and the image washes to uniform gray as the verdict flips to reject — then one click to ultrasonic reads the dermis straight through the puddle, and dropping the threshold to 0.35 lets a total stranger's finger unlock the phone.
- **robot-vacuum/** — The orange laser fan sweeps the room one revolution at a time while gray obstacle blocks pop in along the walls; crank the odometry-drift slider and the solid robot visibly parts ways with its blue ghost, smearing the map until a scan-match snaps pose and map back into register — then switch to random bounce and watch the coverage curve turn into the slow ragged gray line.
- **usb-fast-charging/** — Plug in the dumb 5 V brick and the power bar crouches at 10 W; one click to the PD charger and the log rolls Source_Capabilities → Request → Accept as the bar leaps to 45 W and current particles stream down the cable — drag SOC to 79% and watch the curve hit the dashed line, current collapsing into the slow CV tail while a hot ambient slider forces a live renegotiation down to 9 V.

### Phase 44 deep dives (condensed)

- **gas-spring/** — Two identical doors fall together: the red one accelerates all the way down, slams at 3 rad/s and rebounds twice on its own compressed gas, while the green one hits its damping zone and sinks the last degrees with dignity — the × marks on the oscilloscope tell the whole story. Cut the orifice diameter and watch the crawl get slower.
- **intermittent-gear/** — A driver whose teeth occupy only one arc hands the driven wheel exactly n₁ tooth pitches, then a smooth locking rim glides into driver-centered recesses and freezes it dead — the red "lock window" lights up while the driver keeps spinning. Drag the toothed-arc slider and watch the square-wave speed trace stretch its dwell shelf.
- **power-split-ecvt/** — Three speeds welded onto one tilting lever: drag road speed and watch MG1 sweep from −5000 rpm through zero as the engine fires, then follow power particles as they fork between the direct mechanical route and the sun→MG1→battery→MG2 detour in real time.
- **catalytic-hydrogenation/** — Watch an H2 molecule land on the metal and split into two glowing H atoms, then an ethylene lying flat collect them one by one before ethane leaps away — while the energy-diagram dot hops the 45 kJ/mol staircase that bypasses the 170 kJ/mol wall. Flip the CO switch and the whole dance freezes as gray molecules squat on the sites.
- **diazo-azo-dyes/** — Two pale rings drift together and snap onto a yellow -N=N- bridge: the conjugation bar stretches, the absorption curve lunges from UV into the visible band, and the solution flashes to its complementary color. Push the temperature slider past 5 °C mid-reaction and the diazonium dies in a puff of N2 bubbles.
- **solvent-extraction/** — The funnel rocks, settles, and the violet CCl4 layer suddenly carries most of the color while the water pales; drain, refill, shake again, and the "n portions" bar collapses toward zero far faster than the "one big portion" bar. Push pH past the pKa and watch deprotonation drag every particle back into the aqueous layer.
- **autophagy/** — A damaged mitochondrion gets bagged by a growing double membrane that seals overhead like a drawstring, docks with a purple lysosome, and dissolves into golden amino-acid motes drifting back into the cell. Slide nutrients low to release mTOR — or push damage past 75% and watch cytochrome c burst out instead.
- **flagellar-motor/** — A cutaway flagellar motor where white protons spiral into stator channels one by one, each transit flashing the ring and kicking the rotor ~14°. Raise the attractant slider and the top-view trace on the right visibly relaxes from a drunken zigzag into a straight run.
- **rna-splicing/** — A pre-mRNA of colored exon blocks and gray intron threads; the spliceosome cinches the intron into a lasso, snips it free, and the exon junction flashes where the phosphodiester seam closes. Flip the E2/E3 skip switches and the same transcript splices into a visibly different protein strip.
- **magnetic-reconnection/** — Two antiparallel arcades creep together until the X-point flashes: the lines snip and re-tie, a new loop snaps shut below while a plasmoid and a shower of particles blast out under a flare flash, and the energy ledger on the left moves from blue magnetic to orange kinetic in real time. Switch scenes to load Earth's magnetotail from the dayside and pop an auroral substorm.
- **quantum-superposition/** — Two ghost spin arrows share one atom, their opacities set by cos²(θ/2) and sin²(θ/2), while a measurement ring snaps each trial to + or − and the histogram crawls toward the dashed theoretical line. Push the photon-eavesdropping slider and the sinθ·sinβ interference term — the only quantum thing left — fades into a classical mixture.
- **stern-gerlach/** — A beam of silver atoms bends inside knife-and-groove pole pieces while the screen jumps from the classical orange ghost-band to two crisp dots. Chain z→x→z analyzers and the filtered beam that refused to split splits again — the x measurement ate its memory.
- **microlensing/** — Two image arcs flare and slide around the Einstein ring while the light curve climbs to 20x on the same screen; as the source sweeps the planet's own tiny ring, a narrow spike pops onto the curve live — u₀, planet mass, separation and t_E all retune the event in real time.
- **moon-formation/** — Theia skids in at 45°, its iron core sinks through the molten Earth while hundreds of silicate particles splash into a glowing disk that circularizes, drifts across the marked Roche ring and snowballs into a Moon; dial the impact angle toward head-on and nothing stays in orbit.
- **retrograde-motion/** — A top-down solar system where Earth overtakes Mars at opposition while a geocentric overlay — a star band that follows the observer — traces Mars' knotted loop in real time; click step 3 and the Z-shaped reversal is drawn before your eyes, with dλ/dt flipping red the instant the sky reverses.
- **snow-avalanche/** — The crown line flashes across the slope with a snap, the slab shatters into tumbling blocks that entrain air into a boiling powder cloud racing ahead of the dense core toward a road; the slope slider swings between "friction locks it" and "it only sluffs", and a snow-shed toggle shows the mitigation working.
- **wave-breaking/** — A real dispersion-solved swell steepens over an adjustable bathymetry, throws a curling tongue that smashes into a bubble cloud in slow motion, and one slope slider morphs the same wave from spilling to plunging to a surging runup — with drifters showing circular orbits turning into onshore drift.
- **wingtip-vortices/** — Two counter-rotating vortex ribbons wind off the tips, sink and diffuse behind a C_L-scaled wing while airflow particles show the downwash-between/upwash-outside split; hit "follower crosses wake" and a small jet banks hard as it spears the core — aspect ratio and winglet sliders rewrite the drag bill on the spot.
- **bezier-splines/** — The control polygon collapses layer by layer into a glowing pen tip that sweeps the curve, and dragging any point bends the curve like elastic. Slide the seam handle onto the tangent and the red comb teeth snap into line at the joint — yet a residual kink in the comb betrays that C¹ is still not C².
- **consistent-hashing/** — Keys and servers sparkle on a 0–2³² ring, each key colored by the first node clockwise. Drop a new node onto the ring and only the keys in its counter-clockwise sector blink red and migrate — the readout shows ~1/N while a hash % N toggle watches almost the whole ring recolor at once.
- **regex-engine/** — The input string drives through the NFA as a stream of token-cars: forks split one car into two, dead ends stall in gray, the double-ring accept glows green. Switch to the backtracking view on (a+)+b with thirty a's and the token cloud doubles every character while the counter races past 10⁹ — the subset engine did the same job in 177 steps.
- **autofocus/** — Two bar-code strips above the lens slide out of register as the target defocuses; sweep the lens and the cyan phase line dives through zero exactly at the sharp image — PDAF snaps home in a step while the orange CDAF crawler takes a dozen wiggling probes up the contrast hill. Dim the lights and even the phase line drowns in noise.
- **esp-stability/** — On a wet 55 m corner the car either plows straight off the dotted line or snaps into a tail-out spin — until ESP switches on: one wheel pulses red, the throttle dies, and the orange actual-yaw curve twists back onto the blue wanted curve within seconds. Flip to snow and even the save becomes a drama.
- **rice-cooker/** — The curve crawls onto the 98 °C plateau, sits there for minutes of simmering, then rockets the moment free water dies — and as it crosses the red trip line the permanent magnet in the cutaway base lets go with a popping lever and the heater glow dies. Set the ratio to 1:4 and the plateau just never ends.
